1360: Vaatara befumah, vikabbelun lah illen teren nesharin.

David malka, zayit raanan ikre kammeh kudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Tehillim 52:10) vaani kezayit raanan bevet vegomer. ale zayit, da malka meshicha bereh dedavid. veda ihu deramiz yona da beyomoy denoach, dichtiv, (Bereshit 8:11) vehinne ale zayit taraf befiha. hahu ale zayit, taraf vechataf likara dileh. bema. befiha. dekayyeyma al resheh, umekabbela yekar mehay yona vehay dichtiv taraf, vela tarfa, (ella) kidchura da, deavayd chela venatzach. bimtivta dirkia, yona dechar hu, miggo deikre yona, ketiv kenukeba, uchetiv kidchura, bezimna dimkabbela yekar (chaser) da.

Migdal da kad tav leatreh, nahir kinhiru deena deshimsha, dichtiv, (Tehillim 89:37) kiso kashshemesh negdi. veaf dechurseyay achara lihevi leh benissin veatin ravrevin. beresh migdal da, it ofin denur (darevarea) deka metzaftzefan, kad salik tzafra, tziftzufa dinimu, delet neimu venigguna kehahu neimu.
Leella mekullehu, zinin acharanin, veshafninin acharanin, deka parchin baavira, salke venachte, nachte vesalke, la mishtachchin lealmin. atvavn ravrevan, veatvavn zeiran, parchin benayyhu.

I chasida kaddisha, beshaata deatvavn parchin, chame bar nash beatvavn ravrevan. ketiv baavira lefum shaata, (Bereshit 1:1-2) bereshit bara elohim et hashshamayim veet haaretz (vehaaretz hayta tohu vavohu vegomer, mehacha ahedarey atvavn ravrevan kemillekaddemin) batshe atvavn zeiran behu, ufarchin, veitchazze minnayyhu ketiv, vayyomer elohim yehi or vegomer, vayyar elohim et haor vegomer. levatar mehaddere atvavn zeiran, uvatshe beatvavn ravrevan, umitchaze minnayyhu dichtiv, vayyomer elohim yehi rakia vegomer. vechen kol ovada divreshit, pelian ravrevan, vecheddu leayynin ovadan deatvavn illen, zakkaa amma dechol da mechakkan.

I chasida kaddisha, man denatir berit, shavvi leh avatroy, veihi lekama. vei tema, man natir laachora. ha netiru rav veillaa mikkolla, denatir leh. uman ihu. tzaddik illaa birchimu saggi. al ben tzaddik vetzedek. veishtechach natir mikkol sitrin. zakkaa man denatir berit da. veal da yisrael, itchazun kol dechurin, denatrin at kayyayma da, kamme malka kaddisha. man ihu deyachil lenazka livra, deihu beemtzau avuha mikkan, veimmeh mikkan, veihu benayyhu. veda kad ihu achare Adonai.

Ta chaze hahu rakia kad sachara begilgula menaggena benigguna, umikal nehimu demayin denavin, la yedia hahu nigguna. kol innun agganin di bearba sitrin, malyayn minneviu demayin denavin. man deihu lego, bitren sitrin kayyeyma tamman. chad bechedva, delet chedva kehahi chedva bealma, lekayyeyma (Tehillim 100:2) ivdu et Adonai besimcha. vechad beyira, delet dechilu kehahu dechilu bealma, lekayyeyma (Tehillim 2:11) ivdu et Adonai beyira.

Chad mayayna demayyay, dinvia missetar mizrach, da hu deamar yechezkel nevia. mehay mayayna, la yachlin lesayyeyma shevacha kol bene alma. baatar deityeylid tamman listar mizrach, let umeka veruma dileh, ella zerata vela yattir.

Kad navin mayya vesallekin, sallekin kol zine margelan dealma, vela naflin levar, hasheta itchazun begavvn chad, lefum shaata naflin illen, veha sallekin, ochoranin, kegavavn ochora, bechol zine gavvnin dealma. nafle innun margelan, vela nafle levar.

Sacharanin dehahu neviu, chezur veshushan sacharin. vela yachlin kol bene alma lemekam al innun gavvnin, kullehu shalhovin melahatan, vela yachlin leistakkela behu. la yedia chashivu deovada. tarpin dilhon menatztzan bechamma gavvnin.
Oved tziyyur, umanu demare alma, chafyayn al telat mea veshivin vachamishsha keruvin ditchotayyhu, batar sevachin acharanin lego. veinnun sevachin sechor daazara lego.
1361: Gufenin perisan, techot gufenin innun keruvin, kullehu gadpin perishan, meshullavan illen beillen. hacha amar rav metivta, dechol man deistakkal beinnun gufenin, menaharin anpoy kinhiru deshimsha.

Innun sevachin deittechaman sechor sechor daazara, kullehu merukkeman, bechutin dinhirin bigvavnin saggiin, melahatan bed mine zehorin deeshsha. shalhovin sallekin, ugevavnin menatztzetzan, ulezimnin shalhovin mishtachche, unehorin ugevavnin sallekin, uvatshe illen beillen.

Shit elef agganin, legabbe innun sevachin, 4 gavvnin, led sitrin daazara, illen innun ravrevin, uneviu demayin chayyin bechol sitre. veinnun nafle beinnun agganin, uvale beatrayyhu veillen mayin la yade lean azlin.

Beemtzau daazara, yekumun kullehu yisrael, veyitchazun kamme malka kaddisha. bistar darom baazara da, ityeylid chad mayayna demayya, veitreme (sefer acher vaatademay) (sefer acher veitrabbe) deka yishtefun mayya kol alma. man deyeul behu, yehon ad birkayim, yeul behu gibbar rav yeul behu ad birkayim, i tinok bar yoma ad birkayim. man deshate minnayyhu yitchakkam, veyitpekach bechachmeta.

Mayayna da nafik miggo margela chada zeera, bechotala dedarom. innun mayin bale go atra (sefer acher go atar da), umittamman yippekun levar mimmakdesha, ad deyaalu lenachal shittim, yishtefun hahu zima, deoldin mayya deshittim. veal da mayin illen baazara, begin innun deitchazun tamman dechurin. havo shatan min mayya, la chayyshe benukeve, bemetayhon leitchazaa kamme malka kaddisha. tu, deha yitpakchun leminda millin setimin demalka illaa, go makdesha da kol hirhurin yishtakkechun, bar hirhura dechedva demalka kaddisha.

Anpa chad nafik, go emtzau dehahu mayayna. amar rav metivta, kad karivna lehahu anpa go mayayna, istallak anpa leella leella, kol ma dekarivna, hachi istallak, yesoda vesharsha dehahu anpa lav ihu ella bemayya. hahu anpa chafe almin. kol gavvnin dealma beinnun tarpin dileh. ibba dileh, la yedia mahu. vela yachlin leminda. veamar, deka shail lemashiach al hahu ibba, veamar, ibba da ganiz, (Zecharya 8:4) leish mishanto beyado merov yamim. man dezache leminda da, linda.

Rakia chad it al hahu anpa, paris leella. mehahu rekia, azil talla al gabbe mayayna da, vela yattir. kad istakkal bar nash lehahu rakia merachik, dame tichla. kariv yattir, dame sumaka. kariv yattir, dame yarok karov yattir, dame chivvavr, delet chivvavr bealma kegineh. talla deka azil minneh, ishteiv behahu anpa, veavid ibba da, veitrabbe. hahu rekia, ihu azil begilgula yattir, mimma deayynin yachlin leistakkela.

Kol innun neture kayyayma kaddisha, (sefer acher baavon) debaun leitchazaa kamme malka, deha la itchazun, ella begin leachazaa deinnun bene geziru kaddisha. veal da, (Shemot 23:17) yerae kol zechurecha, innun bene kayyayma kaddisha. dayik rav metivta, zechurecha, vela zecharcha. deha zachar ketiv, vela zachur, may zechurecha. ella kol innun denatrin kayyayma kaddisha, vela chavan beh, innun havu bene malka, divkol yoma mishtavach behu vedachir lon tadir. veal da zechurecha, hahu deit beh kayyayma kaddisha, dedachir lon malka bechol yoma, delet shevacha kamme malka illaa, (ella) keman denatir kayyeyma da.

Veal da bae deyitchazun telat zimnin beshatta kammeh. telat zimnin amay. ella begin avahan kadmae, dekabbilu lehay berit, kadmaa lechol pikudin deorayyta, uvegin kach telat zimnin innun beshatta. avraham kabbil berit. yitzchak kabbil berit. yaakov hava shelim mekullehu, veal da ketiv beh, (Bereshit 25:27) veyaakov ish tam, shelim mikkolla.

Avraham tamim ikre, vela hava kol kach shelim, aval tam: shelim mikkolla. ma ketiv benoach, (Bereshit 6:9) ish tzaddik tamim haya bedorotav. hava reshim birshimu kaddisha benayyhu. veamar rav metivta, bechol atar dichtiv tamim, derashim birshimu kaddisha, beat kayyayma divrit, uvegin
1362: Denatar berit, ikre tamim bedorotav. ma dela havo kullehu hachi, deinnun mechabbelan archayyhu.

Veal da ketiv, et haelohim hithallech noach. vechi man yachil lemehach immeh. ella kol man denatir berit kaddisha, izdavvevgat beh shechinta, veshariat aleh. uvegin kach, (Devarim 18:13) tamim tihye im Adonai elohecha. tamim tihye, ulevatar im Adonai elohecha. beziuuga chada. dechevan denatir berit da, im Adonai lihevi, vela itperash minneh.

Beavraham ketiv, (Bereshit 17:1) hithallech lefanay vehye tamim, geziru deat kayyayma. hithallech lefanay, mehacha, dela yehach gaver batar itteta, ella kamaha, orach kasher ihu. veha ketiv, (Shemot 23:20) hinne anochi sholeach malach lefanecha. (Shemot 33:2) veshalachti lefanecha malach. leavraham dela hava gazir, dacha leh lekammah. veal da la ketiv heye tamim, vehithallech lefanay. ella hithallech lefanay, dela yeot ant, ad shettehe tamim. vechen bechullehu, kevan debar nash tamim, venatir leh, miyyad hi lekameh, veihu avatrah, kasher ihu leda. legirona ma ketiv, (Shmuel 1 15:11) ki shav meacharay.

Noach gazir hava, vetamim, peria la hava beh, uvegin dela hava beh peria ma ketiv, et haelohim, vela achar haelohim, lekamma la hava, begin dehava gezir, laachora la hava, begin dela itpera. ech hava. et haelohim, samich leh, vela yachil leistakkela beh, delav kasher kol kach.

Beyisrael ketiv, (Shemot 13:21) vaAdonai holech lifnehem yomam beammud anan velayla beammud esh vegomer. kevan deamru yisrael, (Shemot 14:11) hamibbeli en kevarim bemitzrayim vegomer. ki tov lanu avod et mitzrayim. kivyachol, itchalash data. ketiv vayyissa malach haelohim haholech lifne machane yisrael vayyelech meacharehem, vayyissa lemebad behu nukemin.

(Chaser) veal da chadde mashiach, vechadde rav metivta, deka itbassar beda. veamar rav metivta, deha dayik lemashiach veamar, mena hava ledaniel dekaamar, (Daniel Adonai:28) peres perisat malchutach vihivat lemaday ufaras. meinnun atvavn deufarsin ishtema leh. vehacha may hu. amar leh, hachi hu vadday, peres perisat malchutach chayyayva, al yede demashiach achara, ulevatar yishlot melech peras, veyittol malkevavn saggiin, vehu yishlot al ara kaddisha teresar yarche, vehu yishlot veyiktol saggiin, vehahu meshicha, ulevatar yippol, vikabbelun malchuta kaddishe elyonin. veal da, ufarsin, malka defaras, ishtema hacha.

I chasida kaddisha, kamma chedva al chedva, behahu mayayna. behahu mayayna, megaddela kol zine ilanin, denatziv kudesha berich hu began eden, vechullehu kayyme leasvavta, tarpin veevin veanfin, ulechadu libba tadir. velet benayyhu kafna, udeaga, vaanacha, lealmin. zakkaa amma dechol da mechakkan, vechol da ganiz lon.

Amar rabbi shimon, bekarka dehay makdesha, it meillen 40 pelian, amar leh, i ribbi, i ribbi, zakkaa chulakach dechol hay. behahu. al gabbe hahu mayayna rekima, aval let man deyachil leistakkela beh, lezimnin nehiru dileh nehora. lezimnin chashocha, lezimnin gon argevavna. menatztzetzan dela yachlin ayynin leistakkela leella. (sefer acher hahi) hi deshaalt chasida kaddisha, mehahu karka demakdesha, rav metivta la parish minneh, deha ganiz ihu go yardena, veha amena lach ma daamena, aval nishal milla da, vetinda ma detinda.

Yarden da, al veitmeshach zimna chada beshatta, go hahu nahar denafik meeden, lav meinnun arba naharin deitmashshechan minneh, ella beh mammash. kevan demate legabbeh, ihu itmeshach veitpashshat veal go yardena. vechevan demate go karka demakdesha, ishtechach tamman telat yomin, vela itpeshat vela itmeshach leatar achara. veamar rav metivta, dechad ahdar hahu nahar leatreh, shavik tamman, kol zine tziyyurin, deka avid kudesha berich hu began eden, deinnun tziyyurin genizin, ditchot duchetayyhu. (chaser)

Illen hacha veillen hacha, vesalke venachte kidkadmeta. behahu setar darom, it telat mea vechamshin ammudin, mikkol zine margelan. veillen innun dinhirin tadir, venatfin busemin temirin, dela itgallu lealmin. arba agganin bechol
1363: Ammuda veammuda neitzin. vechad innun busemin natfin, meinnun ammudin, nafle behu, veitmalyayn kullehu aganot, vela nafkin busemin levar.

Meinnun busemin, zeminin lezimna deate, leaktera bechol yoma ketorta, kamme malka kaddisha. dela yehvu mikketishu divne nasha. innun busemin la yedia ikkara dilhon, umimma havo, ella meinnun ammudin naflin tamman.

Teren nesharin bechol ammuda veammuda, mitnatztzetzan mitlahatin bechol gavvnin. sheva mea nesharin. innun, parchin, illen hacha veillen hacha, begilgula deammudin. kad istacharan, la yachlin ayynin leistakkela, ducheta divhu.

Telat atvavn baltin ufarchin, mippuma da lefuma da. begilgula deammudin unesharin. kol innun atvavn merukkeman beeshsha chivvavra, vedahava yeroka. teren alfin umea menartin, talyayn ben innun ammudin. uteren alfin umea sheragin, bechol menarta umenarta. dalkin bimama, uvelelya mitdaache, al tzaara deyisrael. kad ate tzafra, dalkin kullehu miggarmayyhu.

Adhavo yatve, amre ha ramash lelya. amar leh lerabbi shimon, i chasida kaddisha, nehiru dealma, tol pinkesa deachmata da, vetol sheraga, uchetov millin illen, deha mata zimna dilan, lefakda kol chad vechad lego kivreh, ad palgu lelya, dekudesha berich hu al go ginta leishtashea bahade tzaddikayyay ucheden kol chad vechad parach letaman. ulemachar nehevi gabbach, hoil veyahavu lan reshu, leashlema dorona deka meshadre lach. parche, bacha rabbi shimon vegaa.

Patach veamar, (Mishlei Adonai:19) ayyelet ahavim veyaalat chen daddeha yeravvivcha vechol et beahavatah tishge tamid. orayyta orayyta, nehiru dechol almin, kama yamin, unechalin, umekorin, umabbuin, mitpashshete minach lechol sitrin. minach kolla, alach kayyme illain vetattain, nehiru illaa (veda) minach nafka. orayyta orayyta, ma ema legabbach, ayyelet ahavim ant, veyaalat chen (gabbe) ella vetatta rechimin dilach. man yizke leyanka minach kedka yeot. orayyta orayyta shaashuim demarach, man yachil legallaa, ulememar sitrin ugenizin dilach. bacha, veail resheh ben birkoy, venashak leafra.

Addehachi chama kema diukenin dechavrayyay sacharaneh. amar leh, la tiddechal bereh deyochay, la tiddechal butzina kaddisha, ketov vechadde go chedva demarach. katav kol innun millin deshama behahu lelya, velaa lon, velahag lon, vela anshe milla. vehahu sheraga nahir kammeh kol hahu lelya, ad deata tzafra. kad ata tzafra, zakaf enoy, vechama chad nehiru dehava nahir birkia, maich enoy letatta. ahdar kemilkaddemin, vechama nehiru bechol rekia, denahir vesalik behahu nehiru diyyukena deveta, bechamma tziyyurin. chada rabbi shimon, ulefum riga, agniz hahu nehora.

Addehachi, ha innun teren shelichan atyayn. ashkechuhu resheh ben birkoy. amru leh shelama aleh demor, shelama leman deillain vetattain baan leakdema leh shelam. kum. kam rabbi shimon vachada behu. amru leh, vela chamit nayycha derucha deavad lach marach, chamit nehiru deveta birkia. amar lon chamena, amru leh beh shaata, appik tehoma be makdesha, veabereh kudesha berich hu beyamma rabba, uminhiru dileh, hava nahir birkia.

Amru leh, rav metivta baa bishlamach, veha yada daanan shelichan legabbach. vechamma millin chadtin attikin, itchaddash beorayyta behay lelya. amar lon, bematu minnayychu, imru chad milla minnayyhu. amru, la ityeyhiv lan reshu lemay deatenan legabbach, aval milla chadta hava legabbach hasheta.

Patach rav metivta veamar (Bereshit 12:1) vayyomer Adonai el avram lech lecha meartzecha vegomer, da begin deitnahara beh nehiru kegavvna da. man dela zache baatar da, yehach veyintal garmeh laatar achara, veyizke beh. aa dedalik, unehora la salik venahir beh, yenaneun leh, visalek beh nehora, veanhir. vahavinan zeminin lemishma, aval begin lemete gabbach,
1364: La baenan leitakkeva, chadde ribbi shimon.

Amru leh, i chasida kaddisha, kol millin di begavvavn beorayyta, millin zeirin innun, bechol milla umilla. veinnun millin zeirin, kama innun millin ravrevin veillain, ad delet lon shiura. deha let begavvavn sefeka, ella beriru deorayyta al bureyeh. vehasheta rav metivta parish millin setimin al da, begin deikara denishmeta, amay la nahir baatar da, vezache leitnahara baatar achara. vead kean la zachenan behu, begin lemete gabbach.

Umilla achara zachenan lemishma minneh, rucha deazla beirtura behahu alma bela benin, inteteh yitavid leh mana leitbenaa ihu. may taama. inteteh ihi sheraga, deitdelikat minneh, vetarvavyyhu sheraga chada havo, nehora da nafak minnehora da, itdaach da, itdelik miggo nehoreh mammash, begin dachada nehora havo.

Hasheta ribbi, nehdar lemillin kadmain, vechad nehdar leatrin, nitol reshu merav metivta, beinnun millin dinkabbel minneh, venema kammach. zakkaa chulakach, deat zache linhorin setimin, mikkol sitrin, meella umittatta, mehay alma, umealma ochara. amar ribbi shimon, milla chada baena leminda, i techul leodaa li. nashin behahu alma, i zakkain lesalleka leella, o hech innun tamman. amar leh, i ribbi i ribbi, beda it lan raza yattira (sefer acher yakkira). begin dela legallaa sitrin detamman, aval da yehach veyittol reshu, venema lach. addehachi parach chad, veitkasse minnayyhu, veazal leh.

Ulefum shaata tav legabbayyhu, amar lon, zemina havina lemeal, vahavu kullehu beittura chada, dedayyayne dina dechad bar nash, dekaim al pitcha degan eden, veinnun keruvin achidu beh, vela shavku leh lemeal tamman, vahava betzaara benayyhu, vetzavavch tzavvchin al gabbe pitcha, ushemau kulehu tzaddikayyay detamman, vehasheta havo mitkannefe kol bene metivte, lemeal legabbe malka meshicha, leayyeyna bedineh. vaatena leodaa lechu, veda chavray itzterich lemehach tamman, decharoza hava abar bechol innun bene metivte. delihevon kenishin hasheta kamme mashiach. natal pitka chada, veyahav leribbi shimon. amar, tol da, veayen bema detamman, ad denete gabbach, parchu tarvavyyhu.

Veribbi shimon natal pitka, vechama ma dechama, berazin detamman, kol hahu yoma. belelya chama sheraga, venafil beh shenata, vedamach ad tzafra. kad nahar yemama, kam ufarach hahu pitka minneh, veha innun tarvavyyhu atyayn, amar leh, kum ribbi, zakkaa chulakach, kum. beginach chamenan vezachenan lechamma sitrin illain, kama chedva achziu lan, kad yahavu reshu legallaa lach, kol ma deat bae. resh metivta illaa nafak legabban, veamar, shailu bishlameh devar yochay, atreh devar yochay, ha panu leh mikkamma yomin. let man deyikrav legabbeh, zakkaa ihu.

Ribbi ribbi, kad parachna (beginach) miggabbach, alana vachamena kol bene metivte, deha mitkannefe lego hechala chada, demashiach tamman, vedayynu dina dehahu bar nash, dekaim al pitcha, shemeh let lan reshu legallaa. itztaar ribbi shimon al da, amar leh, la titztaar ribbi al da, ant teda beda lelya bechelmach. aval dina dayynu aleh, degazar mashiach, delihevi hahu bar nash levar behahu tzaara arbein yomin. lesof arbein yomin, yetzaarun leh bedina, betzaara degehinnam, shaata ufalga.

Vechol da, begin deyoma chada, chad min chavrayyay hava parish millin deorayyta, kad mata lechad milla, yada hay bar nash deyitkeshal beh, veamar lechavrayyay shetoku, la temrun midi. uvegin dishtiku chavrayyay itkeshal behahu milla, veichsif. vehahu kissufa. degarim hay bar nash, dayynin leh behay dina
1365: Kashya, begin dela bae kudesha berich hu leshavka chova deorayyta, afillu kimlo nima.

Dayynu dineh, venafku kol bene metivta. vaana shailna reshu, deha bereh deyochay, shail sheelta da. veal da achziu li, ma dela yedana mikkadmat dena. i ribbi, shit hechalin achziu li, bechamma innugin veiddunin, baatar defarochta perisha beginta. deha mehahu parochta ulehala, la alin dechurin kelal.

Behechala chada, it batya bat paro, vechamma ribbo vealfe nashin, zachyayn bahadah, vechol chada vachada minnayyhu, duchetin dinhorin veiddunin, bela dochaka kelal it lah. telat zimnin bechol yoma, karoze achrizu, ha diyyukena demoshe nevia mehemana ate, uvatya nafkat, laatar defargoda chada deit lah, vechamat diyyukena demoshe, vesagidat legabbeh, veamra, zakkaa chulaki deraviti nehiru da. veda ihu innugin dilah, yattir mekullehu.

Ahadrat legabbe nashin, veishtaddelan befikkude orayyta. kullehu beinnun diukenin dahavo behay alma, bilvusha dinhora, (sefer acher kilvusha) bilvusha didchurin, bar dela nahare hachi, pikudin deorayyta dela zachu lekayyeyma lon behay alma, mishtaddele behu, uvetamayyhu, behahu alma. vechol hane nashin, deyatvin bahade batya bat paro, ikrun nashim shaanannot, dela itztaru betzaara degehinnam kelal.

Behechala achara, it serach bat asher, vechama nashin ribbo vealfin bahadah. telat zimnin beyoma machrizin kamme, ha diyyukena deyosef tzaddika ata, veihi chaddat, venafkat legabbe pargoda chada deit lah, vechamat nehiru dediyyukena deyosef, vechaddat, vesagidat legabbeh, veamart, zakkaa hay yoma, deittearit besora dilach legabbe savay. levatar ahadrat legabbe shear nashin, umishtaddelin betushebchan demare alma, uleodaa shemeh. vechamma duchetin vechedu, it lechol chada vachada. ulevatar ahderan leishtaddela befikkude orayyta, uvetamayyhu.

Behechala achara, it yocheved, immeh demoshe nevia mehemana, vechamma alfin veribbevan bahadah. behechala da, la machreze kelal, ella 3 zimnin bechol yoma veyoma, odet umeshabbachat lemare alma, ihi vechol innun nashin di bahadah. veshirata deyamma mezammerin bechol yoma, veihi bilchodaha amrat mehacha, (Shemot 15:20) vattikkach miryam hannevia vegomer, et hattof beyadah vegomer. vechol innun tzaddikayyay di vegan eden, tzayytin lakal neimu dilah. vechamma malachin kaddishin odan umeshabbechan immah lishma kaddisha.

Behechala achara, it devora, uf hachi vechol shear nashin bahadah, odan umezammeran behahi shirata deihi amrat behay alma. i ribbi, i ribbi, man chame chedva detzaddikayyay, udenashin zachyayn deavdin legabbe kudesha berich hu. lego lego deinnun hechalin, it arba hechalin temirin, deimmahan kaddishin dela itmasran leitgallaa, velet man dechame lon. bechuleh yoma innun bilchodehon, kema daamena lecha, veguverin uf hachi.

Uvechol lelya itkelilan kullehu kachada, begin deshata deziuuga ihu befalgut lelya, ben behay alma, ben behahu alma. ziuuga dehahu alma, itdabbekuta denishmeta benishmeta nehora binhora. ziuuga dehay alma, gufa begufa. vecholla kema deitchaze, zina batar zineh, ziuuga batar ziuuga, gufa batar gufa, ziuuga dehahu alma, nehora batar nehora. hechalin dearba immahan, ikrun hechalin devanot botchot. vela zachena behu lemechome. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, guverin venukeve deazle beorach meshar behay alma, vezakkain lechullehu innugin dehahu alma.
I ribbi, i ribbi, ilmale bar yochay ant, la itmesar legallaa. ziuuga dehahu alma, itavid ibba
1366: Yattir, meiva deitavid behay alma. beziuuga dilhon, beziuuga dehahu alma, betiuveta dilhon kachada, kad mitdabbekan nishmatin da im da, avde evin, venafke nehorin minnayyhu, veitavde sheraggin. veinnun nishmatin, laggiyyorin demitgayyrin, vechol hane ayylin lehechala chada.

Vechad mitgayyra giyyora chada, parcha mehahu hechala nishmeta, vealat techot gadfaha dishchinta, venashkat lah, begin deihu ibba detzaddikayyay, umeshadrat lah lego hahu giyyora, vesharat beh. umehahu zimna, ikre ger tzedek. vehayeynu raza dichtiv, (Mishlei 11:30) peri tzaddik etz chayyim. ma ilana dechayye appik nishmatin, uf hachi tzaddik, ibba dileh avid nishmatin.

Rav metivta amar, ketiv (Bereshit 11:30) vattehi saray akara en lah valad. mimmay deamar vattehi saray akara, let ana yodea delet lah valad, may en lah valad. ella hachi amar rav metivta, valad la havat molida, aval nishmatin havat molida beitdabbekuta detiuveta, deinnun teren zakkain havo molide nishmatin legiyyore kol hahu zimna dahavo vecharan. kema deavdin tzaddikayyay began eden. kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 12:5) veet hannefesh asher asu vecharan, nefesh asu vadday.

Chadde rabbi shimon, amar leh hahu gavra, i ribbi, ma ema lecha, bechol resh yarche veshabbatte umoadayyay uzemanayyay, innun dechurin sallekin leitchazaa kamme malka kaddisha, dechurin vela nukevin, kema deat amer (Shemot 23:17) yerae kol zechurecha. vechad ahderan mehaderan bechamma mille chadtin, veahderan millin kamme rav metivta.

Yoma da ahderan millin chadtin kamme rav metivta, al razin attikin, tzaddik vetov lo, tzaddik vara lo. dechullehu sallekin go matkela deilana, ad la yetun lealma, uchefum takla dematkela, hachi it lon behay alma. rav metivta, nachit vegalle mimma deshama leella, milla chada galle vela yattir. aa dela salik nehoreh, yevatshun beh veanhir. gufa dela salleka beh nehora denishmeta, yevatshun beh, visalek nehiru denishmeta, veyitachadun da beda leanhara. (tere navesachey)

Begin deit gufa dinhiru denishmeta la nahir beh, ad divatteshun beh, keden nahir nehiru denishmeta, veitachadat begufa, vegufa itachad bah. gufa keden salik nehiru miggo nishmeta, mehaddar meromam umeshabbach, metzalle tzeloteh uvauteh, mevarech lemareh, ha keden kolla nahir. begin deit gufa, dela yachilat nishmeta leanhara beh, ad divatteshun beh, ucheden nahir veitachad da beda. it aa dela itachad binhora, vela salik nehora beh, ad divatteshun beh, ucheden nahir.

Sitra achara, bae lemebad hachi, uvatash bechayyayvayya, vechol ma devatash, keden (Mishlei 13:9) vener reshaim yidach. mecharef umegaddef lechol sitrin, vela yachil leanhara kelal, ucheden ketiv (Kohelet 2:12) ki me haadam sheyyavo achare hammelech. uvae leitdame leh, vela yachil. veal da (Tehillim 11:5) Adonai tzaddik yivchan, uvatash beh, ucheden nahir veittakaf binhiru. yivchan, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 28:16) even bochan. gachin ribbi shimon, venashik leafra. amar, milla milla avatrach redifna, miyyoma dahavina, vehasheta ishtemoda li milla, miggo sharsha veikkara decholla.

Amar leh, i ribbi, i ribbi, kad sallekin leella, kol innun ruchin dechurin venukevin, behahu zimna, shamin (sefer acher kema) millin chadtin veattikin, nachtin vealin lego metivta, veahderan mille kamme rav metivta, veihu olif lon milla al kiyyumeh. kad sallekin mitpashshetin malbushehon vesallekin. kad nachte, mitlabbeshin bilvushehon dehahu gufa.

I ribbi, i ribbi, kama chadtin millin miggo rav metivta. zakkaa ihu man deazar garmeh behay alma, kama ihu rav veillaa behahu alma. vehachi patach rav metivta, man deihu zeer, ihu rav. uman deihu rav, ihu zeer. dichtiv, (Bereshit 23:1) vayyihyu
1367: Chayye sara mea shana veesrim shana vesheva shanim. mea deihu cheshbon rav, ketiv beh shana, zeiru deshanin, chad azir leh. sheva, deihu cheshbon zeer, asge leh, verabbe leh dichtiv sheva shanim. ta chaze, dela rabbe kudesha berich hu, ella lidazir. la azir ella lidrabbe. zakkaa ihu man deazir garmeh behay alma, kamma ihu rav beilluya behahu alma.

Addehachi shamu shirata deyamma, bekal neimu dela shamu miyyoma deitberiu, kal neimu deshirata, kehahu neimu dahavo amre. vechad siyyeymu (Shemot 15:18) Adonai yimloch leolam vaed. chamu 4 diukenin birkia. vechad minnayyhu rav veillaa mekullehu. vehahu rav veillaa minnayyhu, ittear kala veamar, (Yirmeyahu 2:2) ko amar Adonai zacharti lach chesed neurayich ahavat kelulotayich vegomer. shat birkia veagniz, kam achara avatreh veamar, (Yeshayahu 42:16) veholachti ivrim bederech lo yadau bintivot lo yadu vegomer. siyyem veshat birkia veagniz.

Patach idach veamar, (Yeshayahu 35:1) yesusum midbar vetziyya vetagel arava vetifrach kachavatztzalet. veshat birkia, veagniz. patach idach veamar, (Yeshayahu 43:1) ko amar Adonai boraacha yaakov vegomer, (Yeshayahu 43:16) ko amar Adonai hannoten bayyam darech uvemayim azzim netiva vegomer. techabbedeni chayyat hassade tannim uvenot yaana vegomer. siyyem veshat birkia, veagniz. keden dechilu saggi veemtani nafal alayyhu.

Kad hava nahir yemama, kala ittear kemillekaddemin, veamar, amma takkifa kearye, gibbarin kinmarin, havu yekar lemarechon. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 25:3) al ken yechabbeducha am az vegomer. shamu kal. chelin umashiryayn dahavo amre, (divrei hayamim 1 29:11) lecha Adonai haggedula vehaggevura vehattiferet vehannetzach vehahod vegomer, ad umeromam al kol beracha utehilla. tavvhu veazlu. addehachi nahar yemama, ahderu resha, vechamu kol madbera chappe baanane yekar, menaharan, menatztzetzan, bigvavnin saggiin.

Amru da leda, vadday kudesha berich hu bae leishtabbecha betushebachta dedara demadbera, dela hava bealma, dara illaa, kedara da. vela yehe ad deyete malka meshicha vadday kol ma deachme lan kudesha berich hu, la hava, ella begin leodaa lan chavivu demarehon alayyhu. leodaa deit lon chulaka tava, veinnun bane alma deate. ulezimna deate kad yokim kudesha berich hu metayyay, zeminin illen leachayay bekadmita. kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 26:19) yichyu metecha, veillen innun dara demadbera.

Amar leh, i milla chadta yadat, daana artira bah. amar leh ema. amar kala dehadra baena leminda. bar nash yahiv kala bechakla, o baatar achara, vehadera kala achara, vela yedia. amar leh, i chasida kaddisha, al milla da, kama kalin ittearu, vechamma dikdukin havo kame rav metivta, vechad nachit rav metivta, amar, hachi ukemuha milla bimtivta dirkia, veraza yakkira ihi.
Ta chaze, telat kalin innun, dela itavidu lealmin, bar kalin deorayyta utzelota, deillen sallekin leella, uvakin rekiin. aval kalin acharanin innun dela sallekin, vela itavidu.

Veinnun telat: kol chayya beshaata deihi al kalbita, hahu kala meshatteta veazla baavira, missayyfe alma ad sayyfe alma. kol devar nash, beshaata, denafik nishmateh migufeh, hahu kala meshatteta veazla baavira, missayyfe alma ad sayyfe alma. kol nachash, beshaata defashit mashkeh, hahu kala meshatteta baavira, veazla missayyfe alma ad sayyfe alma.

I chasida kaddisha, kama milla da rabba veyakkira. illen kalin, ma itavid minayyhu, ulean atar alin vesharan. illen kalin detzaara innun, veazlin vemshatte baavira, veazle missayyfe alma, ad sayyfe dealma, vealin go nekikin umechilin deafra, veittammeran tamman. vechad
1368: Yahiv bar nash kala, innun mitarin legabbe hahu kala. kala denachash, la ittear legabbe kala debar nash. heach yittear. bemachaa. kad mache bar nash machaa ittear kala denachash, deittammar legabbeh hahu kala, velav kala achara. kala ittear batar kala, zina batar zineh.

Veal da beyoma derosh hashshana, kol shofar, ittear kol shofar achara, zina batar zineh azla. archeh denachash levish ihu, lekatla ulemachaa, behahu kala mammash, la ittear kala dehay nachash, ella batar zineh. veda ihu, kad bar nash mache bechutera beara, vekare leh lezineh, keden ittear hahu kala denachash, leatava lezineh. veraza da ihu temiru.

Amar rabbi shimon, vadday milla da milla setima hi. vetavvavhna ech shelomo malka la yada milla da. amar leh, shelomo malka minda yada, vela kol kach. aval ma dela yada, hahu kala ma toalta it bah, vehech yatva.

Verav metivta hachi amar, dikduka da la yada shelomo malka, deha hahu kala, ihi kelila rucha venafsha, vehaval garme meitztzevona devisra, umeshatteta baavira, vechol chad mitperash da min da. vechad mata lehahu atar deal beh, yatva kemeta. vechol innun charshin vekosmin yadin atrin illen becharshayyhu, vegachnin leara, veshamin kala da, demitchabberun innun rucha venafsha, vehaval degarme, veodin milla. veda ihu (yeshaya 29) ov meeretz. veal da radif shelomo, leminda ma deitavid mehahu kala, vela yada. zakkaa chulakach ribbi, deitberir lach milla dikshot.

Kad bar nash ittear kala, miyyad (mitchabberan) ittear hahu kala, velet leh reshu learka yattir. ella keen hahu kala, deittear bar nash, vela yattir. vei arich bar nash kale, ihu lo arich kol kach bahade, ela lesofa dekala, begin dela yachil learka. may taama, begin dechad nafka bekadmita, itarich missayyfe alma ad sayyfe alma, vehasheta deal tamman, la yachil learka kala, deha let leh atar leitpashta tamman kidbekadmeta.

Chadde rabbi shimon veamar, ilmale la zachena lemishma, ella milla da, day li, lemehevi chadde, dezachena lemishma millin dikshot, dehahu alma. amar leh, i chasida kaddisha. ilmale yadat chedva demillin behahu alma kamme rav metivta, tehe chadde yattir.

Amar leh, may chiddusha hava hasheta, kad atit legabbay. amar, rav metivta patach veamar, (Bereshit 46:4) veyosef yashit yado al enecha. chedva hu. amay setimu deayynin lemita. begin deayynin, gavvnin dehay alma innun, vechezu udeyyukena dehay alma behu, ihu astim minneh hay alma, chezu dehay alma. astimu enoy, kol chezu dehay alma, ha itchashach minneh. vecheshchin minneh chezu deenoy, let leh chezu behay alma, mittamman ulehala. amar rabbi shimon, yaut tikkuna dekadmae, vechachmeta dilhon yattir mimmalachin kaddishin.

Amar leh, yosef amay yashit yado mikkol benoy. vei tema al besora dileh, mibbae leh veyosef chay tire. amar leh yashit yado begin dirchimu dileh hava, uvegin kach da astim minneh nehiru dehay alma, veda natil leh. man deastim enoy, rechima dileh achze hachi: chezu dilach dehay alma itavid, ha ana chezu dilach beatrach. mikkan ulehala yittatkenun lach chezu achara, dehahu alma.

Amar rabbi shimon, ma ithane hay lemmita, uma toalta it leh behay. man deyive lemishal yoma ma deitzterich leafkecha enoy, begin leachazaa deadayin izdeman ihu, leatava lechezu dehay alma kidbekaddemin.

Amar leh i chasida kaddisha, vadday i la astim minneh kol chezu dehay alma, vela itavid kolla minneh, la lehevi leh chezu vechulaka dehahu alma. alma da, behippucha ihu mehahu alma daanan beh, divzimna ditchiyayt metayyay, afilu kechuta desaara la hava meovada dehay alma, decholla itavid bekadmita, (talla ybetayl leh, veyishvi leh) behahu
1369: Talla (bekadmita) veyitavar minneh kol zuhama, ulevatar yitavid kachamira da, uminneh yitavid gufa birya chadta, kach hacha.

Amar leh ribbi shimon, vday yedana deattun melubbashin tamman, bilvush yekar, degufa dachya kaddisha. i hava begavvna da behay alma, bar nash deitchaze behahu gufa, kegavvna deattun kayymin behahu alma.

Amar leh, milla da shailu kamme rav metivta, teren uleymin deitlebashu benana, batar desavlu tzaara al chova, dela itchaze legallaa, veshaillu da kamme rav metivta. veihu amar, deha hava behay alma hachi. menalan. dichtiv, (Ester Adonai:1) vayhi bayyom hashshelishi vattilbash ester malchut, itlabbeshat behahu diyyukena dehahu alma. malchut: da rucha dekudesha, deha malchut shemaya, nashiv rucha, mehahu rucha daavira dehahu alma, veitlabbesha beh ester.

Vechad alat kamme malka achashvirosh, vechama hahu levusha dinhora, diukenaa idmi lemalach elohim. parcha minneh nishmeta lefum shaata. mardechay uf hachi, dichtiv (Ester 8:15) umardechay yatza millifne hammelech bilvush malchut. levush malchut, vday, diyyukena dehahu alma. veal da ketiv, (Ester 9:3) ki nafal pachad mardechay alehem. pachad mardechay, vela pachad achashvirosh. amar ribbi shimon, kama metikin innun millin, zakkaa chulaki, veha yedana detzaddikayyay (sefer acher behay) behahu alma, mitlabbeshan bilvusha deikre levush malchut, vehachi hu vadday.

Amar leh, avira degan eden, neshivu deruach kudesha innun, umitlabbeshan beh tzaddikayyay, kegavvna dahavo behay alma. ulevatar, ruach kudesha sharat, al resha dechol chad vechad. veitattar veitaveda leh atara. vechach hava lemardechay, dichtiv bilvush malchut, diyyukena dehahu alma. ulevatar vaateret zahav gedola, da ateret, dishriat al reshehon detzaddikayyay behahu alma. kad kabbilu yisrael orayyta, kegavvna da hava lehon. ad dechavu, dichtiv behu, (Shemot 33:6) vayyitnatztzelu vene yisrael et edyam mehar chorev. itpeshatu mehahu levusha.

Vechen ketiv bihoshua kahana rabba, (Zecharya 3:4) hasiru habbegadim hatztzoim mealav. uchetiv vayalbishuhu begadim, illen levushin dehahu alma. mehacha millin kadmain. umehacha, dechol zimna degufa dehay alma kayyeyma bekivra bekiyyuma, la itlebash rucha bilvusha dehahu alma. dichtiv vayyasiru habbegadim hatztzoim mealav bekadmita. ulevatar vayalbishuhu begadim. umalach Adonai omed, mahu omed. ella da hi atara, deikre malach Adonai, dekayyeyma al reshehon detzaddikayyay veda ihu omed. omed al resha leella. levatar deitlabbeshan behay levusha dikar.

Teren gufin kachada, la yachlin lemekam, kol zimna dehay kayyaym, rucha la mekabbela achara. itavar da, ha achara zemina miyyad, vday, da nafik, veda al. kegavvna deyetzer tov veyetzer ra. behay alma. la bae kudesha berich hu detarvavyyhu yekumun kachada.

Amar leh, tavvavhna al ma dichtiv, (Zecharya 3:1) vehassatan omed al yemino lesitno. vechi yehoshua ben yehotzadak kach, shear bene alma al achat kama vechamma. amar leh, chasida kaddisha, kama temirin setimin milin illen, (amar leh) af al gav dechavrayyay yadin bemillin dehahu alma, la yachlin leminda berazin illen.

Amar leh, kevan devar nash behahu alma, ma toalta it lehahu satan leastaa leh, vela day leh deappik nishmateh minneh, vekatil leh. amar leh i chasida kaddisha, zakkaa chulakach. ta chaze tiuveta desatan la hava, ella begin dela yitlabbash hahu zakkaa bilvusha dachya kaddisha, dechevan dechaze hahu satan, dilvusha dileh itdachya, vela itchashiv, al da aste leh. may taama. begin dei itlebash behahu levush yekar, miyyad levusha dezuhama, veavidta dehahu satan, yitbatal veyyaavor mealma, vela nicha leh lesatan.
Vetu, divchol zimna dela itlebash, pakda rucha lehahu gufa dezuhama dileh, venicha leh lesatan. vechevan deitlabbash
1370: Behahu levush yekar, ha itbetil gevavne deyitzra bisha, vegufa dileh, velet leh ducherana bahadeh lealmin.

Vei tema, daanan pakdin leve kivre beresh kol lelya, lav al gufa ella al nafsha. (deazla aretayraah) deha kol zimna devisra kayyeyma, rucha pakda ala denafsha, venafsha pakda legufa. aval hasheta, pikdona dilan ihu lenafsha, deihi mishtakkecha. veishtearat beshichuche go garme. uvegin kach, beresh kol lelya, pikdona derucha lenafsha, vela al bisra.

I chasida kaddisha, ta veagalle lach milla setima. binyayna degufa devar nash hachi hu, rucha meim rucha dekudesha. (yitro 73, 99 amud bet, 236 amud bet) nishmeta miggo ilana dechayye. kevan derucha kaddisha, yahav chela, miyyad retichin dileh. yahavin chelayyhu. chela dilhon, garme veshayyfin. kullehu missitra dilhon, vetikkunayyhu da al da. sitra achara yahavat bisra, umissitra dilah, atya bisra, vela milla achara. retichin dilah, yahavin kol innun gidin vearkin, leamshacha dama levissera. batar deillen yahave chelayyhu, shemaya yahave chelayyhu, uman innun. or deitmeshach al kolla. kegavvna dilhon.

Levatar mitchabberan shemaya veara kachada, veyahave 4 yesode illen: eshsha, umaya vaavira, veafra. leaggana al illen, ulechafya al kolla. levatar, kol chad natil chulakeh deyahav, veitbattel. rucha dekudesha, uretichin dileh, chulakayyhu kayyeyma. rucha dekudesha, rucha dileh kayyeyma venishmeta salleka. retichin derucha dekudesha, garmin dilhon kayymin. veal da chashivu degufa, garmin havo. uvegin kach ketiv, (Yeshayahu 58:11) veatzmotecha yachalitz. uvisra la ketiv beh hachi.

Vechol zimna devisra desitra achara kayyeyma bekiyyuma, hahu satan kayyeyma leastana. itavid bisra, let leh reshu leastana, deha let leh al ma deyistemich. veal da ketiv, (Iyov 33:21) yichel besaro meroi veshuppu atzmotav lo ruu. mehahu chezu desatan dekayyeyma leastana, dela yachil, kevan deyichel besaro. veshuppu atzmotav lo ruu, la itchazun lekarva legabbeh, delet leh behon chulaka, kevan deshaf kol chad vechad midducheteh, la tava alayyhu, vela kaim leastana beginayyhu. levatar devisra mitakkela, ha la yitba dina, vela kaim leastana, deha let leh al ma deyistemich, vela idkar lebar nash beshum milla dealma. amar ribbi shimon, hasheta yedana millin al tikkunayyhu, vadday yaut hu leh leastana.

Amar leh ribbi (shimon), chagor zenach, vetakin garmach, i tive leminda millin desharit. o i tishal behane millin, ema li. amar leh vday, ha yedana devetay shechivat, dela yedana minnah kelum. vechavrayyay yadin. nashin may tama datayyhu kalla.

Amar leh data atya beshit dargin, vechol chad natil chulakeh, ma deishtear, kal ihu. aval yakkira da, i lav deeshet kesilut ishtetaf ba. bemilla da la tishal, deha yedana delav al devitach shaalta, ella al ma dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 19:1) hinne Adonai rochev al av kal. vehahu av kal ikre daat, mehahi kalla yirat Adonai, veihi kayyeyma beemtzaita kegavvna dedaat illaa, aval (veal da) ikre kal. veha yedana sheelta dilach may hi.

Aval share vachagor zenach, vekatir kitrach, deha idana hu legallaa, kema desharit ovada. deal anpe rochav beta, ulam daazara lego. behay azara, it teresar pitchin, lefum chusheban shivtayya deyisrael. befitcha chada, ketiv reuven. uvefitcha achara, ketiv shimon. vechen kol shivtayya deyisrael, reshimin al innun pitchin. bezimna disalkun leitchazaa kamme mareh dealma. man deayil befitcha derashim beh reuven, i mishshivta diruven ihu, mekabbelin leh pitchin, vei la paltin leh levar. vechen bechullehu, dela yekabbelun pitchin, ella leman deihu mehahu shivta derashim behon. uveda yitchakkekun veyishtemmodun kol chad vechad.
Telat mea veshittin vechamesh ammudin dinhora melahata, it bechol sitra, meinnun arba sitrin. kol illen ammudin, ikrun ammudim chayyim. begin dela kayyeyma nehora dilhon
1371: Shachich beatar chad. vechullehu, illen sallekin, veillen nachtin. yahave ducheta da leda. illen desallekin batshin da beda, umenaggene nigguna. veillen denachte uf hachi. illen desalke denaggene nigguna, may nigguna menaggene. shir yatma. (Tehillim 98:1) mizmor shiru laAdonai shir chadash ki niflaot asa vegomer. shir chadash, vechi it shir attik. ella shir, dead kean malachin kaddishin la shabbachu leh, begin deihu chadash. may taama ihu chadash. begin dehahu dimchaddesh ulemoy, meshabbach leh, veamar leh. vehachi amar rav metivta, da ikre chadash veihu chadash. begin dedavik beshimsha, vela itperash minneh. leappaka sitra achara, delet beh chiddusha, dichtiv beh (Kohelet 1) veen kol chadash. zaken hu veitbele, vela itchaddash. (sefer acher velo avid toladin deilmale avid toladin hava mateshatesh kulle alma)

Tu patach rav metivta. sara itchaddashat beidduna, darga dilah garim, dichtiv, (Bereshit 18:12) achare veloti hayta li edna. may edna, meshichu deeden illaa. uvegin deitmeshach ala missetar denukeba, ketiv edna beHei uvegin kach ketiv hayta, velo haya.

Vadoni zaken. vechi af al gav deihu zaken, la itchaze leolada. ella lav milleta zeerta amra legabbeh, (deavraham ella) divgin (laazaar garmah deitdabbekat) hahu (melech) zaken, (davar acher deitdabbeka) (uchesil) la itchaddash vela avid toladin, deilmale hava avid toladin hava metashtesha alma. (ella amra legabbe deavraham, begin dehu zaken lo ytechadesh velo avid toladin) veal da ahdar millin kudesha berich hu, lamma ze tzachaka sara vegomer. vei tema veha ketiv (Bereshit 24:1) veavraham zaken ba bayyamim. ella ba bayyamim, beinnun yomin illain, dimchaddeshe ulemin kenishra. veal da nigguna da nigguna dehahu chadash ihu. hoshia lo, leman. lehahu chadash, hoshia yemina demalka illaa, uderoa dileh.
Innun denachte, uf hachi menaggene, veamre shira achara yatma. uman ihu. (Tehillim 100:1) mizmor letoda, deihu yatma, uf hachi.

Nehora dilhon chad itchaze. vechad mitgalgele, itchazan chamesh gavvnin dinhorin. bechol ammuda veammuda. ammudin illen kullehu chalulin millegav. vechad salke venachte, nafke minnayyhu shalhovin denura, kegvavne chezur veshushan. leella mikkol ammuda veammuda, it telat tappuchin, devatshe behu telat gavvnin, sumak yarok vechivvavr. bechol gon ugevavn melahatan atvavn balte, mishshalhova yeroka deeshsha, vela mishtachche lealmin. velet man diykum alayyhu.

Arba galgallin metachaman ovad tziyyur, bechol ammuda veammuda. beinnun galgallin, it pelian ravrevan. kad mistacharan mappekin minnayyhu zaggin dedahava veavne yekar. umiyyad mitkanneshe vegavavyyhu, vela nafle leara. kad nafkin innun zaggin dedahava, veinnun avne yekar go istacharuta degalgalin, ishtema kala deamre, (Yeshayahu 54:17) zot nachalat avde Adonai vetzidkatam meitti neum Adonai.

Teren aryayn bechol galgalla vegalgalla, arya chada missitra chada, vearya chada missitra chada, vechullehu meeshsha yeroka, uvegilgula deka mistacharan galgallin, mitchabbekan illen beillen. veazle kullehu, begilgula mitdabbekan da beda. kad sallekin ammudin, menahaman aryayn illen beillen, vetappuchin parchin baavira, vesallekin leella, uvatshe illen beillen baavira. vetavu leatrayyhu, umittamman nafle. vearyayn pashte yedayyhu lenatla lon, vesallekin illen miggarmayyhu. i chasida kaddisha, man chama chachmeta deumanu, detziyyer kudesha berich hu beamudin illen.

Befalgu yoma nafke teren nishrin bechol galgalla vegalgalla, vela yedia atar denafke mittamman, vesharyayn al reshehon deillen aryayn. ucheden mishtachche ammudin vegalgelin, vekayyme bekiyyumayyhu. vetappuchin nafle al pumayyhu denishre, umekabbele lon. umiyyad parchin mippuma lefuma, veazlin umeshatte benayyhu, vetavu leatrayyhu, vela yedia man hi. levatar shaata ufalga, nishrin arimin kala, umenaggenin nigguna taiva, veittammeran, vela yedia behe atar.
Sacharanayyhu deinnun ammudin, it sevachin ovad tziyyur. eshsha sumaka, unehora chivvavra, vechutin dedahava, sechor sechor, sacharin lechol setar. umayayna demayya
1372: Kema deat amer vehaya bayom hahu yetzu mayim chayyim miyrushalayim chetzyam el hayyam hakkadmoni vechetzyam el hayyam haacharon.

Hacha parish rav metivta kera da lego, vekaleh ishtema levar. middahava parish kera da. (i kaddisha i kaddisha) kal yenoka ittear millevar, hahu yenoka dehava parish talmudeh, vegamir kamme chad ammuda dealma, bereh deribbi yehuda, deravit ant. vahavu achde beh ledina, vekaleh ittear millevar, behay kera, veamar, mayya deinnun millera hech sallekin leella minneh, laatar illaa yattir minneh, bechamma dargin, uma itzterich lon leinnun mayin leella. uma atar dechol (tappuche) mabbuin unechalin nafkin minneh, velet pesiku lemabbue venachale, itshakya meatar nagiv, man chama chafira devera, yahiv mayin lemabbua dinvia. vechi yerushala 40, yahiv mayin el hayyam hakkadmoni, atar dechol memin dealma nafke mittamman, venavin minneh. i chasida kaddisha, lekala da ishtechachu, vetzayytu kol kalin divne metivte detamman, uvegin kach la yachilu mare dedina lemikrav gabbeh.

Bacha ribbi shimon, amar leh la tivke butzina kaddisha, zakkaa chulakach, deafillu yennuke, minnach amre razin setimin deorayyta. ta, veema lecha, ma deavdu bene metivte al kaleh dehahu yenoka, kad al kaleh dehahu yenoka, kegira lego, vechullehu tzayyte leh. behahi shaata izdaza rav metivta, vechol innun dahavo kammeh, veamar, man innun dela shavkin lehahu bera deelaha chayay, lemeal. kamu veachidu beh telat ammudin dekayyme kamme rav metivta, veal. vechol bene metivte itkenashu legabbeh, amar rav metivta, emma keraich bera kaddisha.

Amar, ad kean dachilna, deha ana mimmetivta acharina havina, vehachi amru li, kad mare dedina havo achadin be. amar leh, la tidchal bera kaddisha, hacha tehe benana shiva yomin, vetitseche bechol yoma mittalla kaddisha. ulevatar yesallekun lach. lego hahu metivta bishar yannuka dehacha.

Patach hahu yennuka veamar, vehaya bayom hahu. hahu, la yedia man hu. ella bechol atar bayom hahu, yoma batraa hu, amay ikre yom hahu. ella da hu yoma deachid sofa besheruta. sheruta ikre hu, kema deat amer (Bamidbar 18:23) veavad hallevi hu pulechana delevi, ledarga deikre hu, tamir veganiz. veikre hahu (Adonai hu), leachazaa sofa dechol dargin, deihu sheruta, vecholla chad. uvegin deihu sofa, ittosaf beh Adonai. (sefer acher vaavad hallevi hu tamir veganiz. veikre yom hahu, leachazaa sofa dechol dargin, deachid sheruta vecholla chad)

Zemina yerushala 40 leappaka mayin, ulenava neviu, hacha it lomar, sofa dechol dargin, lav ihu yerushalam, ella vadday yerushala 40 veyoma hahu kolla chad. ma ben hay lehay. ella yerushalam, kol dargin kaddishin dilah, kad istacharan, ikrun yerushala 40. vehachi ittechaman. veit dargin desacharan, veikrun azarot, illen penimain, veillen levar. veit dargin deikrun kad istacharan, leshachot. (sefer acher kad istacharan illen penimain, veillen levar. ikrun yerushalam. veit dargin desacharan, veikrun azarot, veit dargin deikrun leshachot) veit dargin deikrun kad istacharan. hechol udevir. lego mikkol innun dargin, it chad nekuda, (Tehillim 45:14) kevudda vat melech penima. nekuda da, ikre yom hahu, vesimanich (Devarim 3:13) hahu yikkare eretz.

Vechad yekum yoma da, miggo sevachin daazara yekum neviu demayya, vehahu neviu min hayyam hakkadmoni lehevi. kegavvna deimma, divrah ben deroaha, umissegiu chalava deyanik, itmele pumeh, veitrabbe beh, arik chalava lefuma deimmeh. kach chetzyam el hayyam hakkadmoni.

Natleh rav metivta, uneshakeh. amar chayyecha (sefer acher chayyin dealma demilla da hachi), ukemuha bimtivta dirkia, vehachi hu vadday. yam haacharon: dargin batrain dilah. i chasida kaddisha, kama chedva al chedva, ittosaf behahu yannuka, go bene metivte. 27 taame deorayyta, amar hahu yannuka. veshivin kitrin atteruha laavuha behahu yoma. zakkaa chulakeh, man dezache lemelaf livreh. amar ribbi shimon, la zacha avuha lemelaf leh. amar, avuha shavak.
1373: Hava behay yannuka, al ma deistallak mealma, veal devau lemedan dineh, (sefer acher beitgalleyay) veishteziv minneh, da hava beitgalyay, dehava machsif lerabbeh kamme kolla, bisheltin vekusheyayn dileh, vela chayish lemehach leachara, leatkena talmudoy, vechalish data derabbeh. veal da bau lemedan leh bedina takkifa. uvegin kach, af al gav deishteziv mimarehon dedina, la ishteziv hacha. shiva yomin havi dela ishtelim deyukene. (sefer acher dineh) vekad hava estachi, bikkeeva yattira kame kola kol inun shiva yomin ad deishtelim diyyukeneh. veal deistallak mealma la tive leminda. i ribbi, i ribbi, zakkaa chulakach.

Ta chaze, techot iggula deinnun sevachin, detamman beinnun mayin dehahu neviu demayayna, itreshim neviu chad, veitpashshat venafik levar, veal go yamma rabba. (detamman) verashim beh archa belibba deyamma, uminneh shate livyatan, veravvi, vechadde, veitrabbe beribbuyay. vechad nafik neviu achara, hahu neviu itpeshat veazil bitmiru, techot tehoma, lego yamma batraa. vechol innun mayim zedonim, umayin takkifin, maich lon, vechafif lon, dela yippekun lechabbela bene alma. vesiman (Yeshayahu 43:16) hannoten bayyam darech uvemmayim azzim netiva.

Uveemtzaita dehahi azara, it teren keruvim, ovada deumana demalka kaddisha. vela yachlin lekayyeyma behu, illain vetattain. utechotayyhu zeminin kol yisrael lekayyeyma, dela yippekun mittechot gadpayyhu levar, zakkain lihevavn, kol dealin techot gadpayyhu. telesar alfe migdalin deshimsha, denahir minitzotza demargela betzitzua (sefer acher baneytzevatzea), kedka yaut. rav metivta begin kach zacha lehahu yekar.

Man yachil lememar, meinnun millin deka mitchaddeshan bechol yoma, mikkamme rav metivta, i ribbi, bechol zimna deruchin dechurin sallekin leella. nashin behahu zimna nafke kullehu, umitkanneshe lego hechala devatya tamman, vechaddain tamman, bechamma millin attikin. umittamman nafkin, vealin kullehu. vehi immehon, lego hechala deserach. vechaddan bechamma millin chadtin veattikin, umittamman nafkin vehi immehon, vealin lego hechala deyocheved. vechen bechol innun hechalin.

Hasheta ribbi ema lach raza chada. ta chaze, bechol shemitta ushemitta, karoza nafik, itkenishu guverin venashin, vechol innun bene mehemnuta, useliku. keden kullehu mitpashshetin dechurin venashin, vesallekin. vechol innun yannuke mechalav, alin lego metivta (sefer acher itkannishu bene mehemanuta guverin venashin vechol inun yanoke mechalav useliku. keden kullehu mitpashshetin dechurin venashin, vesallekin. vechullehu alin lego metivta) dirkia, vechaddan chedva, veilluya dilhon, vetamman chedu al chedu. vehahu naar demaftechan demareh bideh, kam veamar lon kama millin chadtin veattikin, vechullehu chaman chedva, delet chedva kehahi chedva.

Levatar alin kullehu lego kama perochtin, vechamma hechalin genizin tamman. deinnun naharin benoam Adonai, bego hechala deahava dekudesha berich hu. veda hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 27:4) lachazot benoam Adonai ulevakker behechalo. (127 amud bet, Shemot 113 amud bet) levatar parchin yannukin leella, veinnun parchin letatta, umehadderin leduchetayyhu, umitlabbeshan kidbekadmeta. zakkaa amma dechol tuva dehahu alma mechakkan.

Amar rabbi shimon, kama metikin millin deshamana. zakkaa chulaka didi, dezachena lechol hay lemishma, zakkaa yoma denafikna hacha. amre leh ribbi, telat yomin it lan reshu lemete gabbach, ulevatar yoma chad (sefer acher nezil velo it lan reshu lemete, behahu yoma ittosaf) 40 chedva dilach. 40

Ihu mashich meshichu missitra dileh, veittammar veitchappa techot atar deikre (Melachim 1 14:28) ta haratzim, ad palgu lelya. mibbatar palgu lelya, shalhova deammuda deyitzchak nafik, uvatash behay tarnegola deikre gaver, kegavvna degever achara illaa aleh. kevan devatash beh hay gavar, kare veyahiv shit kalin, vechullehu besachletanu.

Beshaata deihu kare, kol tarnegolin dehay alma karan, venafik minneh shalhova achara, umate lon techot gadfayyhu, vekaran. ihu ma kare. beshaata kadmaa kare veamar, (Tehillim 29:4) kol Adonai bakkoach kol Adonai behadar. uveshaata tinyayna kare veamar, (Micha 6:9) kol Adonai lair yikra (Tehillim 29:4) kol Adonai shover arazim. beshaata telitaa kare veamar, kol Adonai chotzev lahavot esh.
1374: Beshaata reviaa kare veamar, (Tehillim 29:8) kol Adonai yachil midbar vegomer. beshaata chamishshaa kare veamar, kol Adonai al hammayim vegomer. beshaata shetitaa kare veamar, kol Adonai yecholel ayyalot vegomer. levatar kare veamar, (Yeshayahu 40:6) kol omer kera veamar ma ekra vegomer. veda ihu tarnegola dekare, vela shachich ulevatar kare kemillekaddemin.

Umay kare. kol ovadin divne alma, begin deihu mareh deachmeta (sefer acher dechachmeta) vekeset hassofer bechartzoy. vechol ovadin divne alma kativ bechol yoma. uvelelya, batar dekare kol kerian illen, kare kol ma dechatav beyoma.

Veilmale ragloy etzbean dileh, deinnun teren dargin, chad hahu dekayyeyma beemtzaita. deihu rav. vehahu dekayyeyma meachora, deihu zeer, deka meakkevin leh, yehe mokid alma beshalhovoy. uma avde. kevan desalik tzafra, vechuta dinhiru nafik mistar darom, keden mitchabberin kullehu, veitavdin teren raglin teren telafayin keegla, lekayyeyma dichtiv (Yechezkel 1:7) vechaf raglehem kechaf regel egel, veha yadat raza da. sheelat anpa degoren. lego baazara da, it telat mea veshittin vachamishsha hechalin, kechushevan yome shatta. uvechol pitcha ufitcha ketiv, (Tehillim 122:7) yehi shalom bechelech shalva bearmenotayich. la yedia may hu behane hechalin, ella kullehu, ittechaman ovad tziyyur. sheva sidrin demargelan ittechaman illen beillen, bechol chad vechad.

I chasida kaddisha, kama meshabbach rav metivta hechala chada, deihu beresh setar mizrach daazara da, begin dearba innun bed sitrin dealma, aval hechala distar mizrach, asge nehorin dileh yattir mekullehu.

Yoma chad, beyamma rabba, livyatan nafik, vechol yamma izdaza, vechol nune azlin lechan ulechan, kad mate livyatan befitcha defitcha dithoma, share lemechde, veishtechach tamman 40 tehome 40, ella hahu 40 kechezu demayayn, veitchappeyayn nehorin, vela itchazun kol innun nehorin, bar nehora dehechala devistar mizrach da.

Hahu margela deka appik livyatan, miggo hahu tehoma deikre sagdon, mimma itavid. ella yoma da deka appik livyatan, deizdaza yamma, yoma deitcharav be makdesha, 9 beav ihu. vehahu margela, dechad dachir kudesha berich hu livnoy, veoshid (Shemot 9 amud alef) teren dimin lego yamma rabba, chad nafil lego tehoma da deikre sagdon, vechad nafil lego tehoma achara deikre gilva.
Begin dechamesh tehome acharanin innun beyamma rabba. aval la chashivin kehane acharanin, vechevan denafle innun dimin, kafaan go tehome chad. vechad atba go tehoma, deikre gilva. 40

Detatta go shemarim dechamra, duredyayn bishin, nafik chad irura mekatrega, mazika kadmaa, veihu berucha diyyukena deadam, 40 kad kariv lego kudesha. kevan demitaver mittamman, uvae lenachta letatta, leitlabbesha bilvusha lenazka alma, nachit hu uretichoy. ulevusha kadmaa deka nakit tavnit shor, diyyukena deshor. vekadmaa lannezikin meinnun arba, shor ihu. veinnun arba avot lenazka alma. vechullehu telata avot nezikin, bar shor, kullehu dileh.

Veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 106:20) vayyamiru et kevodam betavnit shor ochel esev. mahu ochel esev, ha darshinan beh. aval ikkara demilla, mittamtzit hallechem, vela shivat zine dagan, let leh behu chulaka, vela yaut leh lemehevi tamman.
Midduchetayyhu, veillen yatvin beduchetayyhu, ad la nafke illen, zeminin illen, nehiru unetzitzu dilhon, la yachlin ayynin lemisbal. azlin besacharanin, let lehon shechichu lealmin.

Kad estakkal bar nash behay hechala, miyyad beistakkeluta kadmaa, itchaze zeer vela zeer, estakkal yattir, itchaze rav. tu estakkal, itchaze yattir rav, kol ma deistakkal, hachi itchaze beitpashtuta rav veillaa, ad dedame
1375: Beistakkeluta kimlo nima, delet leh shiura.

Ovadin saggiin lego, dela yedia umanu dilhon, minneh nahara ezra, vechol ma deit bah, bar keruvim dinhora dilhon salleka ad rum rekia, bigvavnin saggiin, unehorin menatztzan. elef vachamesh mea vachamishsha veshivin gufenin, avdin evin baazara da. 40

Yattir (Kohelet 4:Adonai) chovek et yadav, bimriru vaaninu dileh, ulevatar ochel et besaro beal karcheh, delet leh reshu leshalletaa al milla achara. ma ithane leh bechol ma deaste veavid veamel, dilvatar let leh reshu, ella al dileh levatar markid vechadde, kakkesil bela data kelal, veazil bela toalta, veachil levisra. uvashshear let leh reshu. meriru deella vetatta, kad yisrael beaku, veachle lon sanehon vela yahave chela beovadin tavin dilhon, leappaka minneh.

Vaafillu mibbisreh deihu mehay setar, avish kamme malka kaddisha, deihu rachum vechannun. aval al dileh, rucha kaddisha venishmeta kaddisha, let illain vetattain yachlin leshalta aloy kelal. veal da kol taskufin, vechol ma deaste hahu ra, dechashiv lemishlat al rucha kaddisha, ulevatar la yachil, veyashuv veochel et besaro. ma toalta hava leh. veod deinnun chappan kullehu keartiraa takkif, velet shechichu leillain vetattain.

Ta veema lecha milla. i tema, dechedu hu lemalach hammavt, kad katil bene nasha. lav. ella begin dechame diruta demareh bechach, achze garmeh bechedu, lemebad reuteh dekudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Tehillim 148:8) ruach seara osa devaro. amar leh rabbi shimon, veha ihu azil umerakked bechedva kamme nashin. amar leh i chasida kaddisha, vadday hachi hu, leachazaa kamme malka denicha leh biruteh demalka. aval nayycha dileh behespeda denashin, ihu rakid veudeneh lehespeda.

Amar leh i hachi, amay azil veaste al bar nash leella, veadkar lechovoy. amar leh, begin deihu zaken uchesil, vechashiv lemishlat al rucha, vechol tiuveteh begine kach ihu, lesof la shallit ella al dileh. bisra dileh. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 7:17) yashuv amalo verosho.

Azil uvae leargesha alma, umaya selikin miggo shear tehomin, uvaan lechappeya alma, innun dimin retichin yattir mikkol eshsha dealma. umiggo tokef dirtichu dilhon, akfu mayya, go yamma denikpe. veilmale deramaz kudesha berich hu chad neshivu missitra deavraham, meamuda dileh, veachze al alma, la yachil lemekam afillu riga chada.

Innun dimin kad naflin go yamma, ishtema kala ben yamma, ad mearta dechappelta. mikal nehimu dilhon deka ishtema tamman, kad alin go yamma, mitaran avahan kadmae, vekamu, vechashvu dekudesha berich hu bae leahappecha alma, ad dekala nafik veamar lon, la tidchalu rechimin kaddishin, beginechon dachir kudesha berich hu livnechon, veihu bae demifrak lon, veattun techomun.

Alfa betin kullehu, meshullavan umittzarfan illen beillen, veitchabberan betzerufa dishma kaddisha. kevan deitchazun atvavn betzerufa da, illen genizin, venafkin acharanin, vechen kullehu. illen genizin, veillen nafkin, kullehu lego bechalula deinnun kaftorim.

Tu parche telat zimnin beyoma baavira venafka levar, vekayyeyma shema bearba atvavn, talyayn baavira shaata ufalga, levatar ganiz da, miyyad nafik miggo avira mechalula dileh, shema ditresar atvavn, parach vetalya baavira, shaata chada, vela yattir. levatar ganiz da, venafka miyyad tzerufa deatvavn acharanin, shema 24 (26) atvavn, vetalyayn baavira shaata achara, veagniz. umiyyad nafke atvavn mechalula achara, shema ditmanya veesrin atvavn, mitatterin kullehu bechitrayyhu, vekayyme shaata ufalga, veagniz da. umiyyad nafke talya baavira, shema deesrin vachamesh atvavn betzirufayyeyhu, vekayyeyma shaata utelat rige, nafke atvavn dearbein uteren atvavn. lealma kayyeyma.
1376: Mishtachche lealmin, balte umenatztze levar, vesalke venachte, let man deyachil lekayyeyma behu, bar mashiach betorach saggi. da ganiz, levatar dekayyeyma teren shatin veesrin uteren regain, vehay shema gelifa dev atvavn ka nafik. vekayyeyma vetalya baavira, shaata ufalga. kol hane shemahan la nafke, vela itchazun, ella zimna chada beyoma, aval innun alfa betin, itchazun parchin baavira, umetzarfin illen beillen, telat zimnin beyoma.

Kad parchan atvavn dealfa betin, illen parchin mikkan, veillen mikkan, umittzarfan kullehu. kad nachit tamman rav metivta, share, mashiach chama betzerufa dealfa beta, atvavn kema dechama daniel, deinnun mametaves nanekapey aalaren.

Kol maale shabbeta, kad mekaddeshin yisrael yoma letatta, karoza kariz learba sitre alma, itkenashu mashiryayn kaddishin, attekanu kurseyayn (kaddishin). man chame chedva, bitlat mea vetishin rekiin, kamma memanan, kamma shiltonin, mitkanneshin leatrayyhu. kevan deyisrael letatta mekaddeshin (lekudesha berich hu), keden ittear ilana dechayye, veakish beinnun tarpin dileh, ruach neshivu chad miggo alma deate, veinun anafin deilana mitnanean, vesallekin rechin dealma deate.
Hahu ilana dechayye ittear, veappik nishmatin kaddishin, ufaris al alma. veim kol da, nishmatin nafkin, venishmatin alin, illen mitare illen, illen nafkin veillen alin, veilana dechayye bechedva.

Ucheden, yisrael kullehu mitatterin beitrin deinnun nishmatin kaddishin, kullehu bechedva benayycha. vechol hashshabbat, it lon hahu chedva, vehahu nayycha, vechol tzaddikayyay di beginta, kullehu sallekin umitannegin beinnuga illaa, dealma deate. kevan denafik shabbata, kullehu nishmatin parchin vesallekin.

Ta chaze, kad ayel shabbeta nishmatin nachtin lesharyay al amma kaddisha. venishmatin detzaddikayyay sallekin leella. kad nafik shabbeta, nishmatin sallekin, innun desharu alayyhu deyisrael. venishmatin nachtin, innun nishmatin detzaddikayyay.

Kevan desallekin kullehu nishmatin desharu alayyhu deyisrael. salke vekayymin bediyyukena kamme malka kaddisha, vekudesha berich hu shail lechullehu, may chiddusha hava lechu behahu alma beorayyta. zakkaa ihu man dechidusha deorayyta amrat kammeh. kamma chedva avid kudesha berich hu, kanish lefamalya dileh, veamar, shimu chiddusha deorayyta, deamrat nishmeta da difloni, vechullehu mukeme hahi milla bitre metivte. innun letatta, vekudesha berich hu leella, chatim lehahi milla.

Ta chaze, kad milla itchaddash beorayyta, venishmeta denachta beshabbeta itassekat beinnun millin chadtin, vesalke leella. kol pamalya dilella, tzayytin lehahu milla, vechayyot hakkodesh mitravin begadpin, umitlabbeshan begadpin. vechad shail lon kudesha berich hu, vela tavin veshatkin, keden chayot hakkodesh ma ketiv, (Yechezkel 1:24) beamdam terappena chanfehen, kema deat amer (Iyov 32:16) ki amdu lo anu od. (Nechemya 8:Adonai) uchefitcho amdu kol haam.

Vei tema, shetika amay karu leh amida. ella, bedibbura it 7 shayyfin demitnaanan bahadeh, libba. rea. kane. lashon. shinnayim. sifvavn. basar. uvishtika kayymu bekiyyumayyhu, bela ninua. veal da kare lashtika amida.

Deha rav hamenuna sava amar, (nusach acher rav metivta) (Tehillim 20:3) yishlach ezrecha mikodesh vegomer. mikodesh, da kiddush yadayim. umitziyyon yisadecha, da hammotzi, deihu said libba devar nash. yizkor kol minchotecha, kol leasgaa milla achara, da nettilat yadayim batrayyta. veolatcha yedashshene sela, da birkat hammazon bezimmun. vei at avid ken, yitten lecha chilvavecha vechol atzatcha yemalle. uveshabbat mekaddesh, da kedushsha rabba. veal milla da, itattaru tzaddikayyay began eden, mishshabbat leshabbat achara.
1377: Gavoah ali lach mevasseret tziyyon vegomer. al har gavoah, hay vadday har haavarim, atar demoshe itkevar. veha ukemuha, dishchinta tesallek letaman, utevasser alma. aval kolla ihu, mevasseret tziyyon, da ihi cheftzi bah, itteta denatan bar david. imma ihi dimshicha, menachem bar ammiel, veihi tippuk utevasser, veihi bichlala dimvasseret tziyyon.

Kala yishtema bealma, uteren malchin yittearun bealma, leaggacha kerava, veyippuk shema kaddisha al alma. ma tevasser vetema. (Yeshayahu 40:10) hinne Adonai elohim bechazak yavo uzeroo moshla lo. hinne secharo itto ufeullato lefanav. hinne secharo itto, dekudesha berich hu kariz bechol pamalya dilella, veyema lon, itkenashu vedainu dina. man demasar nishmateh al kedushat shemi, agreh may hu. veinnun yemrun kach vechach. man desavil kama cherufin vegiddufin bechol yoma alay, mahu agreh. innun amre kach. man deitanash bechol yoma alay, mahu agreh. innun amre kach. hada hu dichtiv, hinne secharo itto ufeullato lefanav.

Mahu ufeullato. ella kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 31:20) ma rav tuvecha vegomer. paalta lachosim bach. da hu peullato. neged bene adam mahu. ella neged ovde kochavim umazzalot. asher tzafanta lireecha, mahu asher tzafanta. vechi man yigzol veyittol min yedoy, ma dehu bae lemehav, dichtiv tzafanta.

Ella puk vechame ovadin derachamanu deavad kudesha berich hu, bema deihu mache, beh yahiv asvavta. bema mache bismala, bimina kariv, uvismala mache. bema demache, beh yahiv asvavta leolam, ketiv (Yirmeyahu 1:14) mitztzafon tippatach haraa, uvetzafon mache. demittamman nafke kol dinin vechol gezire kashyayn. uveh share kol agar tav, vechol tivu, dezammin kudesha berich hu lemehav leyisrael. lezimna deate, kare kudesha berich hu latztzafon, veyemma leh, bach yahavit kol tivu, vechol agar tov livanay, desavlu kama bishin behay alma, al kedushat shemi. hav agrin tavin deyahavit bach.

Hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 43:6) omar latztzafon teni uleteman al tichlai vegomer. vechi archa hachi hu dedarom, lemimna birchan, veha kol birchan missitra dedarom, vechol tavin dealma middarom nafke, veihu amar leteman al tichlai.

Ella behahi shaata, yittear kudesha berich hu leavraham, veyema leh kum, deha mata zimna daana parik livnach, lemehav lon agar tav, al kol ma desavlu begaluta. umiggo deavraham hava bizvinu dilhon, dichtiv, (Devarim 32:30) im lo ki tzuram mecharam, da avraham. hava leh keman dela tav beenoy, veachme garmeh, keman devae deyilkun al chovehon yattir, veyemma gevu mechovehon, gevu mechataehon. amar leh kudesha berich hu leavraham, yedana kolla ihu ma deamrat leanpin. ana uf hachi leanpin. al tichlai, ana bae lefayyeysa lach al banecha. la timna tivu minnehon, la timna agar tav minnehon, kama vechamma savlu al chovehon, uvegine kach omar latztzafon teni. vehayeynu asher tzafanta, veda hu milla (sefer acher datehaa) dehahi mevasseret.

Vetu tevasser zimna tinyayna, beshaata dishchinta tesallek al hahu tura illaa, vetehach utevasser laavahan, miyyad tehach liyrushala 40, vetechome lah becharbana. teul letziyyon, vetamman tekarker kira kemillekaddemin, al atar be motva, veal yekara dilah behahu atar. vetamman omiat, dela titol mittamman, vela tippuk, ad dekudesha berich hu yifruk livnaha, veda cheftzi bah. tevasser kemillekaddemin veamrat, (Yeshayahu 12:6) tzahali varonni yoshevet tziyyon ki gadol bekirbech vegomer. may gadol bekirbech. da kudesha berich hu deihu ate legabbah, leakkama lah meafra, veyema lah (Yeshayahu 52:2) hitnaari meafar kumi shevi yerushalam. yerushalam ihi, viyrushalam shemah vadday.

Uveda uf hachi, kama cheddu al cheddu havi letzaddikayyay began eden. uvegin kach zakkaa ihu, man denishmateh beshabbat ashidat kame malka, al chiddusha deorayyta, dekudesha berich hu, vechol pamalya dileh, vechol innun nishmatin detzaddikayyay dahavo began eden, kullehu mitatterin behahu milla.
1378: Kaddisha, dechamma yekar al yekar, vaatara al atara, meatteran laavuha dehahu bar nash tamman, beshaata deamar kudesha berich hu, itkenashi lemishma chiddusha umillin chadtin deorayyta, mishshemeh difloni bar peloni, kama innun denashkin al resheh. kama tzaddikayyay meatterin leh, kad nachtin. zakkaa chulakehon dechol innun demishtaddelin beorayyta, yoma deshabbeta mishshear yomin. (74 kan)

Raya mehemna (Bamidbar 15:20) reshit arisotechem challa tarimu vegomer, pikkuda da lehaferish challa lakkohen. challa hachi chushebaneh, 43 betztzim, vechomesh betztza, chad mechamesh. veit chomesh chad min chamshin, deihu 50. veda siman magen, deihu michael gavriel nuriel. chala, shechinta. divaatar deillen malachin tamman, avahan tamman. uveatra daavahan tamman, shechinta tamman. uva vaychal, bah tzallena, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 32:11) vaychal moshe et pene Adonai elohav. (Devarim 3:24) adonay yedod atta hachillota lehareot et avdecha. uvah chala zechut avot. uvah tama zechut avot larshaim. dahavo mekabbelim agrayyhu behay alma.

Demisitra dimina, detamman 10 deihu chachma, sheruta dishma daydod, deihu achze zechuta al benaha mimina, detamman 248 pikudin daase. missitra deat Adonai batraa, deihi lismala digvura, detamman lo taase, deinnun 365, detamman nidonin reshaim gemurim, tama lon zechut avot, veithappach lon shem Adonai, 26. veolifna mehaman harasha, (Ester Adonai:13) vechol ze enennu sho li. (ad kan raya mehemana)\

(Bamidbar 15:1-2) vayyomer Adonai el moshe lemor dabber el bene yisrael vegomer veasu lahem tzitzit al kanfe vigdehem ledorotam vegomer. ribbi chizkiyya patach, (Zecharya 3:1) vayyareni et yehoshua hakkohen haggadol vegomer. kama zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu bae bikarehon al kol bene alma, veyahav lon orayyta kaddisha, veyahav lon nevie mehemne, dimdabbere lehu beorayyta, beorach keshot.

Ta chaze, kol nevie unevie deokim kudesha berich hu leyisrael, kullehu itgele kudesha berich hu alayyhu, bedargin illain kaddishin, vechamu ziv yekara kaddisha demalka meatar illaa, aval la kariv kemoshe, dehava kariv lemalka yattir mikkolla, deha zakkaa chulakeh yattir mikkol bene alma, dealeh ketiv, (Bamidbar 12:8) pe el pe adabber bo umare velo vechidot. ushear nevie, havo chaman meatar rechika, kema deat amer (Yirmeyahu 31:3) merachok Adonai nira li.

(Shemot 11 amud bet) amar ribbi chizkiyya, hachi olifna, ketiv (Shemot 2:1) vayyelech ish mibbet levi vayyikkach et bat levi. vayyelech ish: da kudesha berich hu kema deat amer (Shemot 15:3) Adonai ish milchama. mibbet levi: da kudesha berich hu, atar dechachma illaa, vehahu zohar (sefer acher nahar) mitchabberan kachada, dela mitparshan lealmin. mibbet levi: deashre livyatan (sefer acher kol chedu) bilchodoy bealma, hada hu dichtiv (Tehillim 104:26) livyatan ze yatzarta lesachek bo. vayyikkach et bat levi, da kudesha berich hu, atar dinhiru desihara nahir.

Vattahar haishsha vatteled ben. haishsha vadday, kema deat amer (Bereshit 2:23) lezot yikkare ishsha. bekadmita bat levi, hachi hu vadday. vechi bat levi bekadmita, vehasheta isha. ella hachi olifna, itteta ad la izdavvevgat, itkeriat bat peloni, batar deizdavvevgat. itkere isha, vehacha, bat veishsha, kolla bechad darga hu.

Vattitzpenehu 3 yerachim, illen telat yarchin dedina kashya sharya bealma. umay ninhu. tammuz veav vetevet. may ka mashma lan. dead dela nachat moshe lealma, shechiach hava hu leella, veal da izdavvevgat beh shechinta min yoma deityelid. mikkan amar ribbi shimon, ruchehon detzaddikayyay shechichin innun leella, ad la yechotun lealma.

Velo yachla od hatztzefino vattikkach lo vegomer may vattikkach lo tevat gome. dechafat leh besimanaha, lemehevi natir meinnun nune yamma, deshatin beyamma rabba, kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:25) sham remes veen mispar. vehi chafat leh lemehevi natir minnayyhu bechafu (sefer acher desitra deyovla yakkira) divne yamma bela yakkira bitre gavvnin, bechivvavr veukkam, veanach leh lemoshe lemeshat benayyhu,
1379: Leishtemoda benehon, begin dezammin hu lesalleka benayyhu, zimna achara, lekabbela orayyta.

Vattered bat paro. da hi, deatya missitra semala dedina kashya, kema deittemar lirchotz al hayeor. al hayeor dayyka, vela al hayyam. vei tema, ha ketiv (Shemot 17:5) umattecha asher hikkita bo et hayeor. umoshe la hikka ella bayyam, vekaryeh kera yeor. ella yeor hava demacha aharon al yeda demoshe, veshavvyeh kera deihu avad.

Kehay gavvna (Shemot 7:25) veyyimmale shivat yamim achare hakkot Adonai et hayeor, veaharon hikka, ella (sefer acher deal da) ad deata missitra dekudesha berich hu, karyeh kera hakkot Adonai, levatar karyeh bishma demoshe. venaaroteha holchot, innun shear mashiryayn deatyayn missitra da.

(Shemot 2:6) vattiftach vattirehu et hayyeled. vattirehu, vattere mibbae leh, may vattirehu. veha amar ribbi shimon let lach milla beorayyta, o at chad beorayyta, dela it beh razin yakirin veilain. ella hachi olifna, reshima demalka umatronita ishtechachat beh, veinnun reshima devav hei, miyyad vattachmol alav vegomer. ad kan leella. mikkan ulehala letatta, bar hay kera, dichtiv vattetatztzav achoto merachok. achoto deman. achoto dehay ihu, dekara lichneset yisrael achoti, kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim Adonai:2) pitchi li achoti. merachok: kema deat amer, (Yirmeyahu 31:3) merachok Adonai nira li.

May mashma. mashma deinnun zakkain, ad dela nachtu lealma, ishtemodan innun leella legabbe kolla, vekol shekken moshe. umashma denishmathon detzaddikayyay, itmeshach meatar illaa, kema deokimna. veraza demilla olifna, demashma deav veem it lenishmeta, kema deit av veem legufa, beara.

Umashma divchol sitrin, ben leella, ben letatta, middechar venukeba kolla atya veishtechach. veha ukemuha raza dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:24) totze haaretz nefesh chayya. haaretz, da keneset yisrael. nefesh chayya, nafsha deadam kadmaa illaa, kema deittemar. ata ribbi abba uneshakeh, amar vday shappir ka amrat, vehacha hu kolla.

Zakkaa chulakeh demoshe nevia mehemana, al kol shear nevie alma. begin kach, la ishtedal beh kad istallak mealma, bar kudesha berich hu, deaaleh lefargodeh. veal da salik moshe binnevua illaa, uvedargin yakkirin, mikkol nevie alma, ushear nevie chaman batar kotalin saggiin.

(Zecharya 3:1) vayyareni et yehoshua hakkohen haggadol, may ka chama, dehava kaim kame malacha, umitlebash bilvushin meluchelachin, ad decharoza nafik, veamar hasiru habbegadim hatztzoim mealav. amar ribbi yitzchak, ketiv hacha veomed lifne hammalach, may lifne hammalach. dehava dain dinoy, hahu dichtiv beh, (Kohelet Adonai:Adonai) veal tomar lifne hammalach ki shegaga hi. may ka mashma lan. dechol bar nash dela zache behay alma, leitattefa beittufa demitzva, uleitlabbesha bilvusha demitzva. kad ayel behahu alma, kaim bilvusha tinnufa, dela itzterich, vekaim bedina aleh.

Ta chaze, kama levushin mizdammenin behahu alma, vehahu bar nash dela zache behay alma bilvushin demitzva, kad ayel lehahu alma, melabbeshin leh bechad levusha deishtemoda legabbe marehon degehinnam, vehahu levusha, vavy leman deitlebash beh. deha kamma
1380: Gardine nimusin, zeminin leachada beh, veayyle leh laggehinam. ushelomo malka tzavavch veamar (Kohelet 9:8) bechol et yihyu vegadecha levanim.
Tana beraza desifra ditzniuta, arba malchin nafkin lekadmut arba. behu talyayn kaanavim beitkela, tzeriran behu 7 rehitin, sahadin sahaduta. vela kayymin beduchetayyhu.
Raya mehemna tzitztzit pikkuda da ihu leadkara kol pikkude orayyta veginah kema deat amer ureitem oto uzechartem et kol mitztzevot Adonai vaasitem otam da ihu simana demalikka leadkara ulemaabbeda.
Ketoyv (Shemot 28:36) veasita tzitz zahav, veha okimna raza detztzitz leitatra beh kahana rabba. veda ihu tzitz, leistakkela beh ayynin, deihu siman dealma illaa, deitatar beh kahana rabba.
Uvegin kach istakkeluta dileh mechappera al azzut panim, dela kayyeyma lekammeh, ella panim dekshot, raza dechol innun panim illain, deinnun panim
Dikshot, panim deemet. dichlilan beemet deyaakov.
Tzitztzit ihu nukeva, raza dealma tattaa. istakkeluta leadkera. tzitz dechar, tzitztzit nukeva, veda lechol var nash. tzitz lechahana.

Vetanenan, asur leistakkela bishchinta, begin kach it techela, begin ditchelet, ihu kurseyay levet david, vetikkuna dileh. veda ihu dachala min kodam Adonai ledachala mehahu atar. veal da ureitem oto uzzechartem et kol mitztzevot Adonai, veda kurseyay dedayynin bah dine nefashot, kema deokmuha, dechol gavvnin tavin lechelma, bar techela, deihu kurseyay desalik bedina dinfashot.
Ketiv venatnu al tzitztzit hakkanaf petil techelet. venatnu al hakkanaf la ketiv, ella venatnu al tzitztzit. deda ihu dechafe al shear chutin.

Ureitem oto uzzechartem, uchetiv, (Devarim 25:17) zachor et asher asa lecha amalek. may tama da. ella livra defaritz gidra, uneshacheh kalba. kol zimna daavoy bae leochacha livreh, hava amar havi dachir kad nashich lach kalva. uf hacha ureitem oto uzzechartem, deda ihu atar desallekin nishmatin lemedan.

Kegavvna da, (Bamidbar 21:8) vehaya kol hannashuch veraa oto vachay, amay. ella kad salik leenoy, vechame diyyukena dehahu denashich leh, hava dachil, vetztzalle kodam Adonai, vahava yada deihu onsha dechayyayvayya. kol zeman divra chame retztzua daavoy, dachil meavoy. ishteziv mirtztzua, ishteziv mikkolla. man garim leh leishtezava. hahu dechame beenoy hahu retztzua, hahu retztzua garim leh leishtazva. veal da veraa oto vachay, chame retztzua dealke leh, veihu avid leh leishtezava. uf hacha ureitem oto uzzechartem, vaasitem vadday. vei lav, ha retztzua, dehay yigrom lechon, lemehevi tavin lefulechana dili tadir, ucheden vaasitem.

Velo taturu achare levavchem, yimna minnechon bishin orchin acharanin, vadday, lo taturu, vela taavdu bishin. veal da salleka gon techela. da techelet, damya lekisse hakkavod, ma kisse hakkavod, avid levar nash lemehach learcha demeshar, ledakkea leh. uf hay techelet, avid lebar nash lemehach beorach meshar, vadday decholla it ledachala mehay atar, lemehach bemeshar.

Ketiv (Yeshayahu 24:16) mikkenaf haaretz zemirot shamanu tzevi latztzadik vaomar razi li vegomer. mikkenaf haaretz, da kanaf detztzitztzit, deihu kanaf haaretz. zemirot shamanu, illen shear chutin, denafkin vetalyayn meatar illaa, go innun shevilin illain, denafkin mechachma illaa. tzevi latztzaddik, da tzaddik chay haolamim, deinnun chutin innun shepiru dileh, deha minneh nafkin, vechol chuta kelila bitren sitrin. vechad istakkalna, amena razi li razi li, deha miggo raza illaa dechol mehemnuta nafkin. vechad istakkalna bitchelet, vachamena retztzua lealkaa, atar dechilu lemidchal, amena oy li, divne nasha la yade leashgecha uleistakkela al ma mitanshin leshakra, behay bogdim bagadu, deha korin keriat shema bela tzitztzit, vesahadin sahaduta deshikra, veillen innun bogdim debagadu, meshakkere degarmayyhu.

Uveged bogdim bagadu, levusha dilhon bela tzitztzit, ikre beged bogdim. levusha deinnun bogdim devagdu, dimshakre vesahadin sahaduta deshikra bechol yoma. vavy lon, vavy lenafshehon, desalke behahu kurseyay detichla lemedan. vealayyhu ketiv, (Tehillim 101:7) dover shekarim lo yikkon leneged enay, hahu beged dilhon ishtemoda legabbe kol marehon dedinin. vavy lon, delet lon chulaka bealma deate. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, demalbushehon vetikkunehon ishtemodan leella, leotava lon behay alma uvealma deate. (ad kan) (Shemot 43 amud alef vehaya leot vechulei)

Pikkuda da mitzvat tzitzit, kalil techelet velavan, dina verachame benura. eshsha chivvavra la achil, techela achil veshatze. (divrei hayamim 2 7:1) vattochal haola, chivvavr mimina, techelet missemala. ammuda deemtzaita yichud ben tarvayyhu, yarok. uvegin da ukemuha mare matnitin, meematay korin et shema beshacharit, mishsheyyakkir ben techelet lelavan. uvegin da takkinu parashat tzitzit lemikre lah beyichuda.
1381: Amar ribbi yehuda, kamma sahade avid kudesha berich hu leashada behu bivne nasha, vechullehu beeta uvesahaduta kayymin lokovleh. kam betzafra oshit ragloy lemehach, sahadayyay kayymin lokovleh, machrizin veamrin, (Shmuel 1 2:9) ragle chasidav yishmor vegomer. (Kohelet 4:17) shemor raglecha kaasher telech. (Mishlei 4:26) palles magal raglecha. aftach enoy leistakkela bealma, sahadayyay amre, (Mishlei 4:25) enecha lenochach yabbitu. kam lemallela, sahadayyay amre (Tehillim 34:14) netzor leshoncha mera vegomer. oshit yedoy bemille alma, sahadayyay amre (Tehillim 34:15) sur mera vaase tov.

I tzayit lehu, yaut. vei la, ketiv (Zecharya 3:1) vehassatan omed al yemino lesitno. kullehu sahadin aleh bechovoy leella. i bae bar nash leishtaddela befulechana dekudesha berich hu, kullehu sahadin sannegorin kammeh, vekayymin leashada aleh tavan, beshaata deitzterich leh.

Kam betzafra, mevarech kama birchan. anach tefilin beresheh ben enoy. bae lezakfa resheh, chame shema kaddisha illaa, achid verashim al resheh. uretzuin talyayn mehay gisa umehay gisa al libbeh. ha estakkal bikara demareh. oshit yedoy, chame yeda achara, mitkashshera bekishshura dishma kaddisha. ahdar yedeh veistakkal bikareh demareh. itattaf beittufa demitzva, bearba zivyayn dichsuteh, arba malchin nafkin lekadmut arba. arba sahade keshot demalka, talyay mearba zivyayn, vetalyayn behu kaanavim beitkela.

Ma atkela, deihu chad, vetalyayn beh kama anavim, mehay setar umehay setar. kach hay, mitzva chada, vetalyayn beh kama anavim, vezagin uzemorin tzeririn behu, shiva rehitin illen innun shiva tzeririn ditchelta, devae lecharcha beh bechol chad vechad, o leasgaa ad telesar, man deyosif, la yosif alayyhu al telesar. man deyimat, la yimat mishshiva.
Vetana, hay techelet, hu raza dedavid malka. veda chuta deavraham, dezacha beh livnoy batroy. may techelet. tachlit decholla. (vadday) ribbi yehuda omer, kisse hakkavod ikre.
