Ribbi yitzchak amar, shiva kerichan deihi shechinta sheviata decholla vadday. deha hi mitbarcha mishitta acharanin, al yeda detzaddik. vei telat asar, telat asar innun, kema deukemuha bitlat asar mechilan. vehay hi pitcha dechullehu.

Vehi chuta chad, ureshima bigvavnaha, ugevavna dilah nafik, mechad nuna deazil beyam kinneret. vechinneret al shemah itkere. veal da, kinnor hava taluy leella mearsa dedavid, deha (dedavid) vadday ihu kinnor dedavid menaggen meelav, lemalka kaddisha illaa. uvegin kach, gevavnoy ayel ad rekia, umerkia ad kuresyay.

Vehacha ketiv mitzva, kema deat amer (Melachim 2 18:36) mitzvat hammelech hi. (Ester 3:3) madua atta over et mitzvat hammelech. (Nechemya 11:23) ki mitzvat hammelech. vetana, yesoda vesharsha bemalka mitatterin kachada. vehay hu kitra ufitcha lechol shear kitrin. dichtiv, (Tehillim 118:19) pitchu li shaare tzedek. uchetiv, (Tehillim 118:19) ze hashshaar laAdonai. veal da ketiv, ureitem oto uzzechartem et kol mitzvot Adonai, leachlela behay kol shear kitrin. veal da innun sahade sahaduta, vela kayyme beduchetayyhu begin deihi mitzvat.
Vetanenan, tashmishe mitzva, nizrakin. vei tema, ha lulav vaarava vechulei, tashmishe kedushsha innun, amay nizrakin. ella tashmishe kedushsha, begin dirshimin bakketiva dishma kaddisha.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, innun chutin, leachazaa hech talyayn mikkan umikkan, led sitre alma, mehay atar. veihi shalta al kolla. beraza delev, deihi libba dechol hay alma, velibba deillae, vetalya ballev illaa. vecholla hu ballev, denafak mechachma illaa. amar ribbi yitzchak, shiura dehay, (sefer acher veureka) dehay, ittemar beatvavn gelifan deribbi elazar.

Amar ribbi yehuda, amar kudesha berich hu, man devae lemehach batar dachalti, yehach batar libba da, uvatar ayynin dekayymin alah. man innun ayynin. kema deat amer, (tehillim lo) ene Adonai el tzaddikim aval attem lo taturu achare levavchem veachare enechem. may tama
1382: Amar ribbi chiyay, may taama hacha yetziat mitzrayim, dichtiv asher hotzeti etchem meeretz mitzrayim. ella, begin dechad nafku mimmitzrayim, behay chulaka al. uvehay, katil kudesha berich hu katula demitzrayim. veal da beatreh itdechar, uveatreh izdehar lehu beda. may beatreh. begin dehay mitzva, hi atar dilah.

Tane ribbi yesa, ketiv (Micha 7:15) kime tzetcha meeretz mitzrayim arennu niflaot. kime, kayyom mibbae leh, deha bechad zimna nafku vela itakkevu. ella keinnun yomin illain, deitbarcha behu keneset yisrael. kach zammin kudesha berich hu leappaka lehu leyisrael min galuta, ucheden ketiv (Yeshayahu 12:4) vaamartem bayom hahu hodu laAdonai kiru vegomer, zammeru Adonai ki geut asa mudaat zot bechol haaretz. may mudaat zot. begin dehashta ishtemoda zot beittufa demitzva. behahu zimna ishtemoda zot, bechamma nimusin dilah, deyaaved kudesha berich hu atin venissin bealma, keden ketiv (Zecharya 14:9) bayom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen. yimloch Adonai leolam amen veamen.
1383: Kaddisha, begin dishma kaddisha, shalom ikre.

Ta chaze, let alma kaim ella al shalom, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, la yachil leitkayyeyma, ad deata veshara alayyhu shalom. umay hu. shabbat, deihu shelama deillae vetattae, ucheden itkayyaym alma. uman defalig aleh, yitavid mealma.

Tzelafchad palig al shabbat, dehava mekoshesh etzim. uman innun etzim. innun ilanin acharanin (157 amud alef) kidamaran. veinnun millin (sefer acher ilanin) dechol, vechol bakkodesh la sharyay, (mikkan vahala mile dechol beshabbat asir vadday) defalig al shelama dealma.

Ribbi yose amar, ketiv (Tehillim 119:165) shalom rav leohave toratecha vegomer. orayyta hu shalom, dichtiv, (Mishlei 3:17) vechol netivoteha shalom. vekorach ata leafgama shalom dilella vetatta, begin kach itanish hu meella vetattaa.

Vayyakumu lifne moshe vegomer. hay kera ukemuha chavrayyay. ribbi shimon amar, kerie moed kerie ketiv, chaser yod, amay kerie. ella hachi hu, malchuta deara keen malchuta dirkia. veraza da, kol innun kitrin illain, dishma kaddisha itachid behu, kullehu zeminin meatar deikre kodesh, hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 23:2) mikrae kodesh. veematay (98) beshaata demoed zammin bealma, kegavvna deinnun kitrin illain, dizminin mikodesh illaa, hachi name kodesh tatta zammin lecheloy, leatera ulealaa lehu.

Kodesh illaa yedia, kodesh tattaa chachmat shelomo, hachi name ihi zeminat lechol chelaha. veinnun chayyaylin kullehu, zeminin leitattera behay kodesh tattaa, bezimna demoed sharyay bealma. uchegavvna dechelaha kayymin leella, hachi name kayyme memanan deamma, kedugema dilah letatta, veal da ikrun kerie moed. uvegin deinnun letatta, kerie moed chaser, (kegavvna dilella) aval bishlimu yattir innun.

Anshe shem vadday, vela anshe Adonai. veda hu raza, benakvo shem yumat, veokimna. veal da ikre hacha, anshe shem vadday, kevan demisitra digvura ka atyayn, anshe shem innun, ha shevacha dilhon yattir, aval innun natlu legarmayyhu. veitachadu bemachloket.

Boker veyoda Adonai et asher lo. amay boker, vaamay kadosh vela tahor. ella innun missitra detahor ka atyayn, vekadosh kahana. amar moshe, boker, dichden kitra dechahana ittear bealma, i attun kahane, ha boker, palchu avoda devoker, ucheden veyoda Adonai et asher lo veet hakkadosh. et asher lo setam, da levae. veet hakkadosh, da kahana, keden vehikriv elav. velet man deavchin milla, ella boker, i titchazun leishtaara bistar dina, boker la savil lechu, deha lav zimneh hu. vei titchazun leishtaara bechesed, ha zimneh hu, vetishtaarun gabbeh, vikabbel lechu.

Bema. bakketoret. deha ketoret bae leshushevina, leitkattera al yedeh becholla, uleitkashshera. man shushevina. da kahana. uvegin kach, vehaya haish asher yivchar Adonai hu hakkadosh, vela hattahor. teren dargin innun: kadosh. vetahor. kohen, kadosh. levi, tahor. veal da hakkadosh ketiv.

Vayyippelu al penehem vayyomru el elohe haruchot lechol basar. ta chaze, moshe veaharon masru garmayyhu lemmita. bema, begin dichtiv vayyippelu al penehem vayyomru el elohe haruchot, ruchat ketiv, chaser vav. uvegin kach ilana demota hu, uvechol atar nefilat anpin lehahu atar havi. veal da el elohe, el: hada hu dichtiv, (tehillim 7) veel zoem bechol yom. elohe haruchot, deihu atar tzerora denishmatin dealma, vechol nishmatin tamman sallekin, umittamman atyayn. (nusach acher tamman itchazyayn)

Ribbi yehuda patach, (Iyov 34:2) shimu chachamim millay veyodim haazinu li. hay kera elihu amaro. ta chaze, ma ketiv (Iyov 32:3) uvishloshet reav chara appo al asher lo matzu maane vegomer. deha innun haviv amrin millin, veiyyov la hava itnechim alayyhu. mehacha olifna, man deal lenachama leavel, bae leyasseda millin bekadmita,
1384: Deha chavrayyay deiyyov havo amre mille keshot, aval lenachama leh lav, begin devae millin deihu yode alayyhu, (beorach keshot) ucheden yekabbel aleh dina, veyode lemalka kaddisha aleh. ma ketiv, (Iyov 32:4) veeliyyahu chikka et iyyov bidvarim vegomer. deode levatar lekudesha berich hu, vekabbil aleh dina dishmayya.

Ta chaze, ketiv (Iyov 34:10) lachen anshe levav shimu li chalila lael meresha veshadday meavl. lachen anshe levav shimu li, shelemin becholla, leavchana millin. chalila lael meresha, hada hu dichtiv, (tehillim 7) veel zoem bechol yom. veshadday meavl, da samich lokovla da, (veha ukemuha) el shadday. (Iyov 34:10) ki foal adam yeshallem lo, ha bar nash azil behay alma, veavid avidtoy vechate kamme mareh, hahu ovada talya aleh, leshallama leh dina, hada hu dichtiv ki foal adam yeshallem lo, hahu ovada yeshallem lo.

Veim kol da, im yashim elav libbo, kevan devar nash shavvi libbeh ureuteh leatava kamme mareh, keden el elohe haruchot rucho venishmato elav yeesof leittzarra bitzrora dechayye, vela shavik lenafsheh levar, leittedna bedina achara.

Ribbi yose amar, hay milla raza (achara) hu, bedinin temirin dekudesha berich hu. ki poal adam yeshallem lo, leittedna bedine, uveinun ovdin devar nash avid behay alma, vesalik leh leitdana keovadoy, veyitavid mealma, ma ketiv batreh, mi fakad alav artza umi sam tevel kullah. mi fakad alav artza, da hu achuha defarik leh. umi sam tevel kullah, devane beta, uvane binyayn alma, vetikkuna veyishshuva. ma ketiv batreh, im yashim elav libbo. hay bar nash, defakid aleh lemivne binyayna, bae lechavvevna libba ureuta legabbeh dehahu mita. mikkan, bar nash deate al hahi itteta, begin shepiru vetiuveta dilah, ha binyayn alma la itbene, deha reuta velibba la itkevvavn legabbe mita.

Uvegin kach ketiv, im yashim elav libbo, biruta delibba dichavvin legabbeh, keden rucho venishmato elav yeesof, veitmeshach gabbeh, leitbanaa behay alma, ma ketiv batreh, yigva kol basar yachad veadam al afar yashuv, yigva kol basar yachad, hahu gufa yitbele beafra, vechol hahu bisra. vehasheta, adam al afar yashuv, ha chadtutin devinyana kemillekaddemin, veyetuv al afra devinyayna degufa achara, kema dehava bekadmita. veal da, rucha venishmeta bidoy dekudesha berich hu, vechayes alayyhu divne nasha, dela yitavidu mehay alma, umealma achara, begin kach el elohe haruchot lechol basar.

(Bamidbar 17:11) vayyomer moshe el aharon kach et hammachta vegomer. ribbi chiyyay patach (Mishlei 16:14) chamat melech malache mavt veish chacham yechapperenna. kama it lehu livne nasha. leistammera mechovayyhu, ulenatra ovadayyhu, deha bechamma zimnin alma ittedan, uvechol yoma veyoma ovadin bematkela sallekin, umashgichin alayyhu leella, veachtivu kammeh. vechad ovadayyhu divne nasha, la mitkashsheran kamme malka, salik rugeza, vedina ittear, hada hu dichtiv chamat melech malache mavt, veal da bechol yoma veyoma bae bar nash leizdahara mechovoy.

Veish chacham yechapperenna, beshaata demarehon dedinin kayymin al alma, verugeza tale, i ishtechach bedara zakkaa derashim leella, kudesha berich hu ashgach beh, veishtechach rugeza. lemalka deitregaz al avdoy, vahava tava al santira lemebad dina, addehachi al rechima demalka, vekam kammeh, kevan dechama leh malka, itnehiru anpoy. share hahu rechima demalka leishtae bahadeh, umalka chadde. levatar kad ata santira, chaza anpoy demalka chaddan, istallak veazil leh, vela avid dina. ucheden, hahu rechima bae lemalka al avadoy, umechapper lehu. uvegin kach, veish chacham yechapperenna.
Uf hacha, kad chama moshe derugeza hava
1385: Tale, miyyad vayyomer moshe el aharon, begin deihu shushevina dematronita, uketoret la salleka ella bidoy, deihu asge shelama bealma, vekashir kishra dimhemnuta. ketoret, ha ukemuha, chedvavta deella vetatta, kishshura dimhemnuta, seliku derugeza, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 27:9) shemen uketoret yesammach lev, ucheden veish chacham yechapperenna, yenake vidakke lehahu rugeza, verachamin mitarin.

Ribbi elazar (nusach acher rabbi abba) amar, (Bamidbar 4:18) al tachritu et shevet mishpechot hakkehati mittoch haleviyyim, begin deinnun giza vesharsha delevae. vezot asu lahem vechayu velo yamutu, devae kahana leatkena lehu, deaf al gav dikrivin innun lekudesha, la yealun ella betikkuna dechahana, dehu yada simana deyimtun legabbeh, vela yattir. vechad mechasseya lemane kudesha, keden kissuya achara share, veasir lon lekarva lemecheme, deha milla bachashay la it legabbayyhu, ella lechahana, (veal da) demilla dilhon veovada dilhon beraza uvachashay velevae learama kala.

Begin kach kahane bachashay uveraza, veal da asir lon chamra, dechamra learama kala, ulegallaa razin ihu. begin kach levae itmesaru learama kala, deha bedina itachad, dina beitgalyay ihu, ulefarsema milla kamme kolla. aval kahana, kol milloy beraza uvachashay, velav beitgalyay (simana decholla semol tehe doche, veyamin mekarevet). begin deihu yemina (mikkerev), kad dinin sharyayn bealma missitra dismala, yemina yehe mikkerava, uvema. bikketoret, deihu bachashay, beraza dakik, ufenimaa mikkolla.

Ta chaze, kad hay madbecha achara, share leatteara ittearuta, kad la yishtechachu zakkain, madbecha penimaa ittear legabbeh, vekaim lokovleh, vedinin mishtachche. veal da kayyeyma lokovel da, ucheden dina istallak.

Ribbi elazar amar, (Bamidbar 4:4) zot avodat bene kehat beohel moed kodesh hakkodashim, beshaata divne kehat natlin kodesh kodashim, keden ate kahana, vechafe kolla, ad la yikrevun lenatla leh, vela havo chaman lealmin ma deinnun natlin, ella kolla bechissuyay minnayyhu. kema dichtiv, (Bamidbar 4:Adonai) uva aharon uvanav binsoa hammachane vehoridu et parochet hammasach. verov kissuyay demane makdesha, techelet ihu, begin ditchelet ha (123 amud bet) ukemuha veittemar. batar deitkasyay kolla, mekarvin bene kehat denatlin, vela mekarvin ella beinnun baddim denafkin levar. hada hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 4:15) vechila aharon uvanav lechassot et hakkodesh vegomer, binsoa hammachane veachare chen yavou vene kehat laset vegomer.

Begin kach ketoret deihi penimaa, vechol ma di beraza, lechahana itmesar. veal da (Bamidbar 7) vayyikkach aharon kaasher dibber moshe vayyaratz el toch hakkahal vayitten et hakketoret, deihi penimaa, raza dechahana, keden vaychapper al haam vayyaamod ben hammetim uven hachayyim, ben ilana dechayye, uven ilana demota, keden yemina kariv da beda, vatteatzar hammaggefa, zakkaa chulaka dechahana, dechahana it leh chela leella, veit leh chela letatta, vehu garim shelama leella vetatta, uvechol zimna, semala palach limina, hada hu dichtiv veyilavu alecha visharatucha, vimina bismala mishtakkeche bamikdash.

Ribbi elazar hava kaim kammeh deribbi shimon avuha, amar leh, ketiv (Kohelet 9:9) ree chayyim im ishsha asher ahavta kol yeme chayye hevlecha. amar leh, ta chaze, ree chayyim im ishsha asher ahavta (sefer acher vahava amar rabbi shimon ketiv 1 raa chayyim im ishsha asher ahavat) da hu raza, devae bar nash leachlela chayyim baatar da, da bela da la azla. uvae bar nash leachlela middat yom ballayla, umiddat layla bayom. veda hu ree chayyim im ishsha asher ahavta may taama begin ki hi chelkecha bachayim, dechayim la sharan ella al da. uvaamalcha asher atta amel tachat hashshamesh, kema deamar (Mishlei 3:6) bechol derachecha daehu vehu yeyashsher orchotecha.

Veta chaze kol milloy dishlomo malka, kullehu setimin lego bechachmeta, vehane kerae itchazun dehuttara retzua, kema dichtiv batreh, (nusach acher amar leh rabbi elazar ketiv) kol asher timtza yadcha laasot bechochacha ase ki en maase vecheshbon vegomer. hay kera it leistakkela beh, (Kohelet 9:10) kol asher timtza yadcha laasot bechochacha ase, vechi shelomo
1386: Dechachmeta illaa beh, yattir al kol bene alma, amar hachi.

Ella (nusach acher amar leh) kol milloy dishlomo malka al raza dechachmeta ittemaru. ta chaze, kol asher timtza yadcha laasot bechochacha ase, da hu devae bar nash leachlela semala bimina, vechol ma dehu avid, mibbae leh dela yehon ella kelilan bimina. kol asher timtza yadcha, da semala. laasot bechochacha: da hu yemina, kema deat amer (Shemot 15:6) yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach. vechevan devar nash yizdehar dechol ovadoy yehon lesitra dimina, veyachlil semala bimina, keden kudesha berich hu share begavvivy behay alma, veyachnish leh legabbeh lehahu alma deate.

Vela yemma bar nash beshaata daatena lehahu alma, keden etba min malka rachame, veetuv kammeh, ella ki en maase vecheshbon vedaat vechachma, batar deyistelak bar nash mehay alma, ella i bae bar nash, demalka kaddisha yanhir leh lehahu alma, veyitten leh chulaka lealma deate, yishtedal behay alma, leachlela ovadoy bimina, vechol ovadoy yehon lishma dekudesha berich hu, deha levatar kad yitkenish mehay alma, leittedna bedina takkifa, bedina degehinnam, let tamman eta vechachma vesachletanu leishtezava min dina.

Davar acher ki en maase vecheshbon vedaat vechachma bashsheol. begehinnam, it beh madorin al madorin. madora tattaa sheol. madora tattaa minneh, avaddon. veda samich leda. man denachit lishol, yedunun leh umittamman yetzaftzef veole. hada hu dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 2:6) morid sheol vayyaal. uman denachit laavaddon, tu la salik lealmin.

Man deit beh ovada tava, o deihu (sefer acher i tava ihu) mare dechushebana, ha ukemuha divchol lelya velelya ad la yishkav, vead la naim, bae bar nash lemebad chushebana meovadoy deavad kol hahu yoma, veyetuv minnayyhu, veyive alayyhu rachame. may tama behahi shaata. begin dehahi shaata ilana demota share bealma, vechol bene alma taamin taama demota, uvae behahi shaata lemebad chushebana meovadoy, veyode alayyhu, begin deihi shaata demota, veillen ikrun mare dechushebana.

Vechen man deishtedal bedaat uvechachma leminda lemareh, kad yaavrun leh leistachaa uleistakkela beinnun chayyayvin deitteridu bagehinnam, uvedarga dishol, vechullehu tzavvchin meinnun dargin, hu la yishtear tamman, vela yishtekach benayyhu, veal da en maase vecheshbon vedaat vechachma bishol, vela yishtechach ella leella leella, baatar dechamma nehorin uvutzinin, vechamma kisufin sharan beh, vekudesha berich hu ate (beh) (sefer acher vateayb leh) leishtashea im shear tzaddikayyay di began eden. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay behay alma, uvealma deate, alayyhu ketiv (Tehillim 140:14) ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha yeshvu yesharim et panecha.

(Bamidbar 18:23) veavad hallevi hu et avodat ohel moed vegomer. ribbi abba patach, (Yeshayahu 40:22) hayyoshev al chug haaretz vegomer. ta chaze, kad baa kudesha berich hu lemivre alma, salik biruta kammeh, uvara leh beorayyta. (sefer acher kad salik biruta kammeh kudesha berich hu lemivre alma istakkal beorayyta uvara leh) uva ishtachlal. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 8:27) bahachino shamayim sham ani. uchetiv (Mishlei 8:30) vaehye etzlo amon. veha ukemuha, al tikre amon, ella uman.

Kad atte lemivre adam, veha ittemar, amra tora vechi lemaggana itkeriat erech appayim verav chesed. behahi shaata denafik adam lealma, hava ziv partzufa dileh meella umittatta, vahavu dachalin minneh kol biryayn, veokmuha. ta chaze, la itkayyaym alma, vela ishtelim, ad hahi shaata denafak adam bishlimu decholla, veitkaddash yoma, veittekan kurseyay kaddisha lemalka, keden ishtelimu illae vetattae, veishtechachu chedvavn bechullehu almin.
Behahi shaata devaa yoma leitkaddesha, havo nafke ruchehon deshedin leitbere gufa dilhon, veitkaddash yoma, vela itberiu, veishtear alma kema deitpegim meavidata
1387: Veistachar (sefer acher vaatachesar), kevan deitkaddashu (almin) yisrael, veishtelimu bedargehon, veishtechachu levae bistar semala, kad (sefer acher keden) ishtelim hahu pegima dealma, demissetar semala.

Hu: leella lismala. hu: itkelil bimina, tu hu: da attika. (sefer acher ta chaze 39 min tu) ilmale dina la ishtechach bealma, la havo yade bene nasha mehemnuta illaa, vela yishtaddelun bene nasha beorayyta, vela yitkayymu pikkude orayyta, pulechana shelemuta deyishtechach bealma legabbe malka kaddisha, man avid leh. havi omer da levaa.

Vetu veavad hallevi hu, kema deat amer (Devarim 4:35) ki Adonai hu haelohim. hu ashlim shelemuta, lemehevi kolla chad. hu: peshita lekabbela likkeneset yisrael, kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi, begin lechabbera ziuuga kachada. man ittear rechimuta. havi omer hu. tu hu kema deat amer (sefer acher tu hu da attika kema deat amar ki Adonai hu haelohim) (Tehillim 100:3) hu asanu velo anachnu ammo. begin kach hu: letatta. hu: leella. hu: itgalyay. hu satim. hu elohim.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, zammin kudesha berich hu leanhara lesihara, kinhora deshimsha. unehora deshimsha yehe al chad sheva zimnin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 30:26) vehaya or hallevana keor hachamma vegomer. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 60:20) lo yavo od shimshech virechech lo yeasef. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 60:19) lo yihye lach od hashshemesh vegomer.

Raya mehemna (Bamidbar 18:15) kol peter rechem lechol basar vegomer, veet bechor habbehema hatemea tifde. pikkuda da lifdot peter chamor, lifdot lealma deate. vei kodem deazil lehahu alma, la yifde nafsheh verucheh venishmateh beorayyta, atid leachzera lehay alma kidbekadmeta. (Iyov 33:25) yashuv lime alumav, velokovel nafsha verucha venishmeta.

Ketiv (Iyov 33:29) hen kol elle yifal el paamayim shalosh im gaver. veyisrael, begin defidyon dilhon hava bela tora, deihu kesef kissufa dealma deate, ahadru telat zimnin acharanin begaluta, uvefurekana batrayyta defurekana dilhon yehe beorayyta, la yehadrun lealam begaluta. atu rabbanan uvarichu leh, veamru raya mehemana, kudesha berich hu yifde lach, vechol yisrael yippadun al yedach, vetitchaddesh immehon, veinnun immach.

Pikkuda batar da, ladun beerke bayit. uveraza dechachmeta, bayit debar nash, da itteta. i ihi itteta detov vara, uvae lehamir raa betova, yifde lah mehahu ra, veyahiv leh erech dilah. aval itteta deilana dechayye, ittemar bah (Iyov 28:17) lo yaarchenna zahav uzechuchit utemuratah kele paz, veen lah erech. kema deittemar, (Mishlei 12:4) eshet chayil ateret balah. veittemar (Mishlei 31:10) eshet chayil mi yimtza vegomer. veda shechinta. man degamil chesed immah, let erech leagra dileh. uman dechav legabbah, let erech leonsha dileh.

Kama shefachot it lah dimshammeshin lah, vechol chada vachada minnayyhu, it lah erech. vechol chad vechad tzarich pidyon. aval man deyarit nishmeta, o rucha, o nafsha mishchinta, la tzarich pidyon, dishchinta alah ittemar (Yeshayahu 42:8) ani Adonai hu shemi uchevodi leacher lo etten. defidyon dilah bekudesha berich hu talya. deamshechan lah (legabbeh) yisrael, bekishshura ditfillin, beot deshabbat, beot deyomin tavin, beot divrit, vetora, bechamma pikudin. defidyon dilah talya bekudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv, (Yechezkel 20:9) vaaas lemaan shemi, uvegina (Vayikra 26) veaf gam zot. hachi kama pikudin innun deavdin bene nasha al menat lekabbel peras. vechamma chovin. ulechol pikkuda it leh erech behahu alma. (sefer acher aval onsha) ulechol onsha leman deabar alayyhu, en leh erech veshiur.

Pikkuda batar da, ladun bemacharim nechasav lakkohen, hada hu dichtiv kol cherem beyisrael lecha yihye. veraza da (baadam uvabbehema) kol peter rechem lechol basar asher yakrivu laAdonai baadam uvabbehema. rechem: behifuch atvavn kechusheban
1388: 248 Evarim debar nash, alayyhu ittemar (Chavakuk 3:2) berogez rachem tizkor. batar dechais bar nash, umacharim hahu beira legabbeh, ha sharya el acher nachash, deittemar beh, (Bereshit 3:14) arur atta mikkol habbehema, veihu lismala debar nash. begin da mane kudesha berich hu, lemehav lechahana, deihu rachame beracha, leitkafyay rogez, deittear behahu bar nash mara, charba demalach hammavt, veittear yemina legabbeh berachame, veitkafyay rugeza dismala, vehay ihu berogez rachem tizkor.

Man dechais, deit leh bechaas sam hammavt, dealeh ukemuha mare matnitin, kol hakkoes keillu oved avoda zara. begin desitra achara ittokdat bebar nash. uvehahi beira deyahiv lechahana itperash cherem minneh, vesamael el acher cherem, venukeba dileh kelala, kelula mikkol kelalot shebamishne tora. vekudesha berich hu, barich bechol orayyta kola, vechol birchan mimina, deachid bah kohen. uvegin da kol cherem tzarich lemehav leh lechahana, deihu achil leh benura, veshetze leh mealma, veshachich eshsha missemala bimina, deihu mayyay, uveh (Ester 7:10) vachamat hammelech shachacha.

Pikkuda batar da lehaferish teruma gedola, veokmuha tere mimmea, may teruma. rabbanan dimtivta, hay teruma ditzrichin leafresha tere mimmea, besitre tora may nihu. man devae lemitam, i hu zar yumat vehayeynu el zar samael. dekudesha berich hu amar (Shemot 28) veyikchu li teruma, tere mimmea, leyachada leh teren zimnin beyoma, dehayynu tere mimmea, bemt atvavn dishma uvaruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed dearvit, uvemt atvavn deshachrit, chaserin teren mimmea, innun shechinta illaa, vetattaa, betarvavyyhu tzarich leyachada lekudesha berich hu, amma detarvavyyhu. midda detarvavyyhu. mea baamma. amma beatvoy mea ihu veihu behippuch atvavn, haem.

Veod (Bamidbar 15:19) vehaya baachalchem millechem haaretz tarimu teruma laAdonai, tarimu, kegon (Chavakuk 3:10) rum yadehu nasa, veinnun eser etzbean, disliku dilhon leeser sefiran, deinnun yod hei vav hei, disliku 45. uveatvavn dealfa beta, ma selik mea, 50 95. vehay ihu deukemuha rabbanan mare matnitin, (Devarim 10:12) veatta yisrael ma Adonai elohecha shoel meimmach, veamru, al tikre ma ella mea, lokovel mea birchan dimchuyyayv bar nash levarcha lemareh bechol yoma, vehay ihu detzarich bar nash lematam bechol yoma lemareh, uvegin da veyikchu li teruma.

Vechamma terumot innun, it teruma middeorayyta, tora 40. vehay ihu teruma, tora deityeyhivat bearbaim yom. vei temrun deachilna minnah (nusach acher mena), ha ketiv (Shemot 34:28) vayhi moshe bahar arbaim yom vearbaim layla lechem lo achal umayim lo shata. netirat hava ad hasheta hay teruma lekudesha berich hu. vechevan demalka la achal, ech achlin avde, deha levatar deamar (Shir HaShirim Adonai:1) ariti mori im besami, levatar ichlu reim, yechlun avdoy.

Pikkuda batar da lehaferish (60 levi terumat maaser veihi) (nusach acher terumot) maaser lelevi, veihi shechinta missetar dimina deihu chesed, teruma gedola lakkohen. missitra dismala, deihu gevura, terumat maaser lelevi, deihi shechinta.

Yod he vav he, sheloshet esronim lappar, missitra dehahu deittemar beh, (ychevazekaal 1) ufene shor mehassemol, veda gevura. veissaron lakkeves, veda yod hei vav hei (nusach acher yod 15 vav 15), desalik leeser atvavn, hay issaron. veeser lem um lemmea.

Aval shelosha esronim 10 10 10, (nusach acher da yod 15 vav 15) vesallekin (sefer acher 30 30 6 10) lel, vey sefiran behon, sallekin 43 betzim vecholla yod, chomesh betza, tosefet mitztzad Adonai, vehachi maaser, deihu pikkuda lehaferish yisrael maaser, missitra deat 10, maaser min hammaaser, chad mechamesh missitra deat Adonai. kol issurin deat 10, veihi shechinta chad meeser sefiran. 1 mechamesh, ihu missitra detiferet, deihu chamisha mikketer. vechad tachshov mimmalchut ad tiferet, tishkach tiferet chamesh mittatta leella. ushechinta chamishshaa legabbeh.

Umissitra achara ihi shene esronim laayil, uchelilat 10 10 hakkaf beshekel hakkodesh, asara asara 10 10, laayil da 6, deihu shekel hakkodesh, vehay ihu asara asara hakkaf beshekel hakkodesh. veod, shene esronim, 10 10 min vayyitzer. laayil 6 min vayyitzer. vecholla 1, 10 leella, 10 letatta, 6 beemtzaita. veod shelosha esronim innun 10 10 10.

Pikkuda batar da, lehaferish toda. verabbanan mare matnitin ukemuha, detoda esrim esronim, umitpalgin 10 esronin lechametz, vey lematza. umi shel matztza, osim 30 matztzot. umeasara shel chametz, osim 10 challot. veda ihu solet challot matztzot belulot bashshemen. me esronim, deinnun yod he vav he, havo avdin 30 matzot, deinnun 10 10 10. hay shema, zimnin ihu limina, vezimnin ihu lismala, vezimnin beemtzaita. rachame mikkol sitra, limineh velismaleh.
Vezimnin 10 limina, veen pochatin beh measara malchiyyot. ulezimnin yod lismala, veen pochatin beh measara shofarot. ulezimnin yod
1389: Beemtzaita, veen pochatin beh me zichronot.

(Bamidbar 9:23) al pi Adonai yachanu veal pi Adonai yissau et mishmeret Adonai shamaru. dechol 10 it lah 4 anpin, 3 chivavn innun, lokovel telat yodin, ved anpin lechol chayya, lokovel 4 anpin (sefer acher atvavn) diAdonai, al pi Adonai yachanu veyyissau.

Shamaru, da shechinta, denatra leinnun deshomre shabbatot veyamim tovim, debgin kach la zaza shechina miyisrael bechol shabbatot vyom tov, vaafillu beshabbatot (sefer acher beyomoy) dechol, ella deihu sogeret umesuggeret behon.

Uvechol tzelota, ihu ola laydod, ad dematat lemerkavta daavahan illain, deinnun: gedula, gevura, tiferet, deit lehon teresar anpin, lokovel teresar shevatin. uchefum deihi olifat zechut, al illen mare tzelotin, umare zachvavn, bechol pikkuda ufikkuda deorayyta, hachi yachanu al zachvavn dilhon vechen yissau legabbayyhu. vehachi nachta shemira legabbayyhu.

Innun deavdin zachvavn al menat lekabbel peras, nachit kudesha berich hu bemerkavte deavad, uved shomrin dileh, uman deavid zachvavn shello al menat lekabbel peras, nachit alayyhu bemerkavta dileh. ulerashiayya nachit alayyhu beovadayyhu, beinnun sheddin umazzikin umalache chabbala bemerkavta dilhon, leitpara minnehon. (sefer acher zakevaven shello al menat lekabbel peras kudesha berich hu nachit alayyhu bamerakebatea dileh 12 chevavn dileh. uman deavid zakevaven al menat lekabbel peras nachit alayyhu bamerakebatea deavad 314 12 shomrin dileh. valerasheyaya nachit alayyhu beovadayyhu, beinnun sheddin vamezaykayn umalachi chabbala avon umashchit af vacheymeh bamerakebatea dilhon, leitpara minnehon) patchu mare matnitin veamru. vadday hachi hu, zakkaa chulakach raya mehemana. (ad kan raya mehemana) baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen yimloch Adonai leolam amen veamen (491 275 amud bet veanshu oto vechulei)
1390: Amar leribbi elazar bereh, elazar kum bekiyyumach, veema milla chad befarsheta da, vechavrayyay yemrun avatrach.

Kam ribbi elazar veamar, (Rut 4:7) vezot lefanim beyisrael al haggeula veal hattemura lekayyem vegomer. hay kera it leistakkela beh, vei innun kadmae avde hasekama da bedina deorayyta, veatu batrae uvitluha, amay bitluha. veha man devatil milla deorayyta. keillu chariv alma shelim. vei lav ihu bedina deorayyta, ella hasekama bealma, amay naal hacha.

Ella vadday bedina deorayyta hava, uveraza illaa itavidat milla, uvegin dahavo kadmae chaside zakkae, milla da itgalyay benayyhu, umiddeasgiu chayyayve bealma, itavidat (aberu) hay milla begavvna achara, begin leitkassaa millin deinnun beraza illaa. (veha ukemuha)

Ta chaze, (Shemot 3:Adonai) vayyomer al tikrav halom shal nealecha meal raglecha vegomer. vechi amay naal hacha. ella ittemar, defakid leh al itteta, leitparsha minnah, uleizdavvevga (sefer acher baatar) beitteta achara, dinhiru kaddisha illaa, veihi shechinta.

Vehahu naal okim leh baatar achara, (sefer acher veihi shechinta) abar leh mehay alma, veokim leh bealma achara. veal da, kol ma deyahiv mita levar nash bechelma tav. natil maneh min beta bish, kegon sandaleh. may tama. begin deabar ragleh, deinnun kiuma devar nash, mehay alma, vechanish lon lealma achara, atar demota share beh, dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 7:2) ma yafu feamayich banalim bat nadiv. (may hi bat nediv da bat avraham dichtiv, 2 nedive ammim neesfu im elohe avraham velo elohe yitzchak) veraza demilla ben chavrayyay ihu.

Veda kad mita natil lon, aval bezimna dechayyay shalif masaneh, veyahiv levar nash achara, begin lekayyeyma keyyaym, ka avid bigzera dilella. naal dachalitza, kegavvna dilella naal achara, vecholla atar chad (sefer acher kolla ityachad) (nusach acher raza chada).

Ta chaze, hahu mita deistallak mealma bela benin, hay bat nadiv la kenishat leh lehahu bar nash legabbah, veazil leittarda bealma, dela ashkach atar, vekudesha berich hu chayis aleh ufakid leachuhi lemifrak leh, leatava uleittakna beafra achara. kema dichtiv, (Iyov 34:15) veadam al afar yashuv (177 amud alef) veokmuha.

Vei hahu paruka la bae lekayyeyma leachuhi behay alma, bae lemiktar chad naal beragleh, vehahu itteta detishre leh umekabbela lehahu naal legabbah. amay naal. ella begin dehahu naal begin mita hu (sefer acher begin dehahu naal kiyyuma demita hu behay alma), veityehiv beragleh dechayyay achuhi, veitteta mekabbelah lehahu naal legabbah, leachazaa deha hahu mita ben chayyay ahdar beovada da.

Vehu behippucha mehahu naal denatil mita mechayyay, vehasheta hay naal natil chayay mimmita, uvehahu naal hahu mita azil ben chayay, (nusach acher uvae naal dehahu meta da azil beh bacheyvehay) veitteta natla leh legabbah, leachazaa dehahi itteta ateret balah, natla leh umekabbela leh legabbah.

Uvae levattesha leh lehahu naal beara, leachazaa deshachich gufeh dehahu mita. vekudesha berich hu lezimna da, o levatar zimna, chayis aleh, vikabbel leh lealma achara. tu betashuta dehahu naal beyada (sefer acher mida) deitteta leara leachazaa, deha yitbene hahu mita beafra achara dehay alma, vehasheta yetuv leafreh dehava mittamman bekadmita, (echden yetuv laapareyh) ucheden hahi itteta tishtere lemebad zara achara, veukemuha.

Ta chaze, al da man devae lekayyeyma keyyaym, natil naaleh, veyahav lechavreh, lekayyeyma aleh kayyayma. (devat nediv) hada hu dichtiv, vezot lefanim beyisrael al haggeula. may vezot. kayyayma shelim becholla. lefanim beyisrael, kad havo tzenuin kaddishin. lekayyem kol davar, kol davar mammash, deha da hu kiyyuma. ucheden vezot hatteuda beyisrael, vday. dela tema dehaskama bealma hi, umiddaattayyhu avde lah, ella kiuma illaa hava, lemeheve ovadehon beraza dilella.
Kevan deasgiu chayyayvin bealma, kassiu milla begavvna achara, bechanfa demalbusha, vehay malbusha hi tikkuna illaa, veraza demilla, (Devarim 23:1) velo yegalle kanaf aviv ketiv.
1391: (Bamidbar 19:2) zot chukkat hattora. zot: da at kayyayma, dela itperash da min da (vechad itpera da kolla) deikre ze. uminukeva ayel lidchar. veal da, shamor vezachor kachada mitchabberan. chukkat hattora, chok hattora mibbae leh, may chukkat.

Ella chukkat vadday, (58, sefer acher) veokimna, Adonai 4 havat (nusach acher chok) veha ittemar. aval t, hu 4 ven mechubbar kachada. venun ha ittemar, nun amay ikre hachi benun. ella, kema deat amer (Vayikra 25:17) velo tonu ish et amito. dehashta hi beanpaha nehirin veavda onaa livne nasha, levatar machya kechivya, veshatze vekatil (Mishlei 30:20) veamra lo faalti avn. veal da hachi ikre benun, deittemar aleh. 400 kolla kachada dalet nun. 4 nun dalet resh (hei hei) (106 510), resh vedalet chad milla hu. uveatvavn gelifin innun ta chaze chok vot (sefer acher inun chok 406) vecholla chad milla.

Dabber el bene yisrael veyikchu elecha fara, hay para ledachyuta ka atyay. ledakkea lemisave. para dekabbilat min semala. uman hu lismala. shor. kema deat amer, (Yechezkel 1:10) ufene shor mehassemol. aduma, sumaka kevavrda. dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 2:2) keshoshanna ben hachochim. adumma: gizrat dina.

Temima, may temima. kema detanenan, shor tam veshor muad. (163 amud bet) shor tam dina rafyay. shor muad dina kashya. uf hacha temima dina rafyay, gevura tattaa, da hi temima. gevura illaa, da hi dina kashya, vehi yad hachazaka takkifa.

Asher en bah mum, kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim 4:7) kullach yafa rayati umum en bach. asher lo ala aleha ol. al ketiv, kema deat amer (Shmuel 2 23:1) uneum haggever hukam al. may tama. begin dehi shelume emune yisrael, vealeha lav hi ella immah. asher lo ala aleha ol, hayeynu dichtiv, (Amos 5) betulat yisrael, (Bereshit 24:16) betula veish lo yedaa.

Unetattem otah el elazar, mitzvavtah bassegan, veokmuha. may tama leh vela leaharon. ella aharon shushevina dematronita. veod deaharon la ate missitra detahor, ella (177 amud bet) missitra dekadosh, uvegin deda atyay letohora, la ityeyhiv leh.

Kol milla dehay para, hi besheva, 7 kibbusim vechulei, veha (77 amud bet) ittemar, may tama. begin dehi sheva shene shemitta, uvat sheva itkere, veal da kol ovadoy besheva. ta chaze, kol may deitavid mehay para, begin ledakkea, vela lekaddesha, veaf al gav deityeyhiv lassegan, hu la shachit vela sarif, begin dela yishtekach dina besitroy, vekol shekken aharon deihu bedarga shelim yattir, dela bae leishtakkecha tamman, uleizdammena tamman.

Hay para, kevan deitavid efer, bae lemishde beh etz erez, veezov, usheni tolaat, veha illen ittemaru. veasaf ish tahor, vela kadosh. vehinniach michutz lammachane bemakom tahor, deha tahor la ikre, ella min sitra dimsaev bekadmita.

Raza decholla, hay dichtiv leme nidda chattat hi, begin dechol dinin tattain, vechol innun deatu missitra dimsaava, kad ihu yanka missitra achara, veyativat bedina, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 34:6) mala dam huddashna mechelev. keden kullehu mitare umistalke vesharan bealma. kevan deavde hay ovada diltatta, vechol hay dina baatar da dehay para, veraman alah etz (daf 181 amud alef) erez vegomer. keden itchalash chela dilhon, uvechol atar desharan ittebaru veitchalashu vearkin minneh, dehay chela dilhon itchaze kegavvna da legabbayyhu, keden la sharan bevar nash, veitdakke.

Veal da itkere me nidda, mayyay ledakkea. kad alma share bedina, vesitra misava itpeshat bealma, hacha itkelilan kol zinin mesaava, vechol zine dachyu, uvegin kach tumea vetohora, kelala illaa deorayyta, veokmuha chavrayyay. amar rabbi shimon, elazar, avdat dela yemrun chavrayyay milla abbatrach.

Raya mehemna para adumma temima asher en bah mum vegomer, asur lacharosh beshabbat charisha deshor, deittemar (Tehillim 129:3) al gabbi charshu chorshim. ushechinta tattaa, ihi para adumma, missitra digvura. temima missitra dechesed, deihu darga deavraham, deittemar beh (Bereshit 17:1) hithallech lefanay vehye tamim. asher en bah mum, missitra deammuda deemtztzaita. asher lo ala aleha ol, missitra dishchinta illaa, deihi cheru. baatar deihi shalta, vehazzar hakkarev let reshu lesitra achara leshalletaa. la satan, vela mashchit, vela malach hammavt, deinnun missitra degehinam. (ad kan raya mehemana).
1392: Patach rabbi shimon veamar, (Tehillim 104:10) hameshalleach mayanim bannechalim vegomer. yashku kol chayto saday vegomer. hane kerae david malka berucha kaddisha amaran, veit leistakkela behu. ta chaze, beshaata dechachmeta illaa batash biglifoy, af al gav dehi temira bechol sitrin, patach veitnegid minneh chad nahara, malya (nusach acher vamelayya lateraayn) betarin illain.

Kemabbua umekora demaya demalle kuzefa rabba minneh, umittamman itmashshechan mabbuin denachalin venaharin bechol setar, kach hay, bechad shevil dakik dela ityeyda, mashich venagid hahu nahar denagid venafik, umemalle lehahu nachala amika, umittamman itmashshechan mabbuin unechalin, veitmalleyayn minneh. hada hu dichtiv, hameshalleach mayanim bannechalim vegomer. illen nahare illae kaddisha deafarsemona dachyay, vechullehu itshakyayn kechad mehahu nevia denachala illaa kaddisha denafik venagid.

Levatar, yashku kol chayto saday, hayeynu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) umishsham yippared vehaya learbaa rashim. hane 4 rashin, illen innun chayto saday, kelala dechol innun mashiryayn, vechol innun chayyaylin, daachidan behu saday, al tikre saday, ella shadday. dehu natil, veashlim shema miyyesoda dealma.

Yishberu feraim tzemaam, illen innun dichtiv behu, (Yechezkel 1:20) vehaofannim yinnasu leummatam ki ruach hachayya baofannim, man chayya. ella illen chayto saday, arba innun, vechol chad vechad lechad sitra dealma. vehahu ikre chayya, veofannim lokovel kol chad vechad. vela azlin ella meruach dehahi chayya deazil alayyhu vechad illen mitshakyayn mehahu shakyu illaa, kol shear chayyaylin acharanin ishtakyayn, veitravavn, umishtarshan besharshayyhu, veitachadan illen beillen, bedargin yedian. hada hu dichtiv, alehem of hashshamayim yishkon vegomer. mashke harim mealiyyotav vegomer. illen shear dargin illain.

Levatar kol da, mipperi maasecha tisba haaretz, (sefer acher letatta vechol almin vechulei) ara illaa kaddisha. vechad ihi mitbarcha, kol almin kullehu chaddan, umitbarchan. da beshaata devirkan mishtakkeche, mishshakyu denachala (Bereshit 221 amud alef) amika decholla.

Uveshaata dealma yetiv bedina devirchan la mishtakkeche lenachta bealma, keden isteav mikdash (sefer acher uveshaata devirkan lo mishtakkeche lenachta bealma, keden alma yativ bedina, umissitra dismala rucha ittear veitpashshat bealma) vechamma chavile terikin mishtakkeche bealma, vesharan (bechamma atre) al bene nasha, umesaav hahu rucha lehu, kevar nash degava (sefer acher kevar hay ruach) veruach misava sharya aleh. hachi name sharya, lemaan deyikrav bahadeh.

Hada hu dichtiv, tastir panecha yibbahelun vegomer. hay kera may ka mayyre. ella tastir panecha yibbahelun, deha la itshakyayn leishtakkecha birchan lealmin. tosef rucham yigvaun, (nusach acher leitteara) veittear rucha achara missitra semala, veruach misava sharya al bene nasha, al innun demetin, uman dekaim bahadayyhu, veal shear bene nasha, may asvavta dilhon. ha dichtiv veel afaram yeshuvun. da afar serefat hachattat, (sefer acher da afar makdesha dilella) begin leitdakkea beh. vehayeynu raza (Kohelet 3:20) hakkol haya min heafar, vafillu galgal chamma.

Levatar dimhadrin lehay afar, begin leitdakkea beh, mitavar rucha misava, veittear rucha achara kaddisha, veshari bealma. hada hu dichtiv, teshallach ruchacha yibbareun, yibbareun, veyittesun beasvavta illaa, derucha achara. utechaddesh pene adama, deha itdakkiat, (itteta levalah) vechadtute desihara ishtechach, vealmin kullehu mitbarchan. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dekudesha berich hu yahiv lon eta, decholla asvavta, begin deyizkun lechayye alma deate, veyishtechachu dachyayn behay alma, kaddishin lealma deate, alayyhu ketiv (Yechezkel 36:25) vezarakti alechem mayim tehorim utehartem.
1393: (Bamidbar 20:1) vayavou vene yisrael kol haeda midbar tzin vegomer. ribbi yehuda amar, amay parsheta defara, semicha lemitat miryam. ha ukemuha. ella kevan (sefer acher kema) deitavid dina behay para, ledakkea lemisave, itavid dina bemiryam, ledakkea alma, veistellakat min alma. kevan deistallakat miryam, istallak hahu beer, dehava azil immehon deyisrael bemadbera veistallak bera becholla.

Amar ribbi abba, ketiv veatta ben adam sa kina al betulat yisrael, vechi ala bilchodaha, la. ella begin decholla ittebar beginah. beginah ittebar yemina abbatrah, dehava mekarev lah gabbe gufa. vegufa deihu shimsha, itchashach beginah. veda hu raza dichtiv, (Tehillim 60:7) hoshia yemincha vaaneni. gufa (sefer acher beginah dichtiv, 1 choshech hashshemesh betzeto uchetiv) dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 50:3) albish shamayim kadrut, deha shimsha itchashach beginah. kegavvna da vattamat sham miryam vegomer.

(Bamidbar 20:2) velo haya mayim laeda, deha istallak bera deella vetatta levatar ittebar yemina, dichtiv yeasef aharon el ammav. ulevatar itchashach shimsha, dichtiv, (Devarim 32:50) umut bahar vegomer. veheasef el ammecha vegomer. ha (tetzavve 181 amud alef) deroa yemina ittebar, vegufa deihu shimsha itchashach.

Veta chaze, la ishtechach dara bealma, kedara demoshe kayyeyma bealma, veaharon umiryam. vei tema beyomoy dishlomo hachi namme, lav. deha beyomoy dishlomo shallit sihara, veshimmesha itkenish. uveyomoy demoshe, itkenish sihara, veshimmesha shalta.

Telat achin havo: moshe, aharon, umiryam. kema deat amer (Micha 6:4) vaeshlach lefanecha et moshe aharon umiryam. miryam, sihara. moshe, shimsha. aharon, deroa yemina. (Shemot 66 amud alef) chur, deroa semala. veamre lah, nachshon ben aminadav. bekadmita mitat miryam, istalakat sihara, istallak beer. levatar ittebar deroa yemina, dimkarev tadir sihara, beachva, bechedu. veal da ketiv, (Shemot 15:20) vattikkach miryam hannevia achot aharon. achot aharon vadday, deihu deroa, dimkarev lah beachaduta, beachva im gufa.

Levatar itkenish shimsha veitchashach, kema deokimna dichtiv veheasef el ammecha gam atta vegomer. zakkaa chulakehon demoshe aharon umiryam, deishtechachu bealma. beyomoy dishlomo, shalta sihara, betikkunaha, veitchazze bealma. veitkeyaym shelomo bechachmeta dinhiru dilah, veshalit bealma. kevan desihara nachta bechovoy, itpegim yoma batar yoma, ad deishtechach bekeren maaravit, vela yattir, veityehiv shivta chad livreh. zakkaa chulaka demoshe nevia mehemana.

Ketiv (Kohelet 1:Adonai) vezarach hashshemesh uva hashshamesh vegomer. hay kera okimna. aval vezarach hashshemesh, kad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, denahir shimsha vela sihara. veel mekomo shoef vegomer, ha ketiv uva hashshemesh, bemadbera, im shear mete madbera. kevan deal shimsha, lean atar itkenish. el mekomo, begin leanhara lesihara. hada hu dichtiv shoef zoreach hu sham. deaf al gav deitkenish, zoreach hu sham vadday. deha la anhir sihara, ella minnehora deshimsha. veda hu raza dichtiv, (Devarim 31:16) hinnecha shochev im avotecha vekam. af al gav detitkanesh, hinnecha kayyaym leanhara lesihara. da hu yehoshua.

Veale kach hu moshe veale ketiv hay kera, (Kohelet 1:3) ma yitron laadam bechol amalo vegomer. ma yitron laadam bechol amalo, da yehoshua, deishtedal leachsena ara deyisrael, vela zacha leashlema lesihara kaddeka yaut, deha ihu amal behu beyisrael, tachat hashshamesh techoteh demoshe. ta chaze, vavy lehahu kissufa, vavy lehahu kelima, begin defalach, vela natal atreh mammash, ella techot shimsha, vela hava leh nehiru midileh, ella nehiru denahir leh. vei hachi, may tushebachta hava leh, hoil vela ashlim lehacha ulehacha.
Uvechol atar deamar shelomo tachat hashshamesh, al darga dileh kaamar. (Kohelet Adonai:12) raiti tachat hashshamesh. (Kohelet 3:16) veod raiti tachat hashshamesh. (Kohelet 9:11) shavti verao
1394: Tachat hashshamesh. vechen kullehu. uvegin darga dileh kaamar. veda hu raza demilla vadday.

Rabbi shimon amar, vadday man denatil sama demota bilchodoy, aleh ketiv bechol amalo sheyyaamol tachat hashshamesh vadday. uman hu tachat hashshamesh. havi ema da sihara. uman deachid sihara bela shimsha, amalo tachat hashshamesh vadday. veda hu chova kadmaa dealma. veal da ma yitron laadam bechol amalo, laadam kadmaa, vechen lechullehu deatyayn batreh, dechavu baatar da.
Holech el darom vesovev el tzafon, hayeynu dichtiv, (Devarim 33) mimino esh dat lamo. yemino, ze darom. esh dat, da tzafon. veda kalil beda.

Sovev sovev holech haruach, hay kera kashya, sovev sovev holech hashshemesh mibbae leh, may holech haruach. man rucha da, da hu tachat hashshemesh, deikre ruach hakkodesh. veda (hu) ruach holech vesovev leillen teren sitrin leitchabbera begufa. veal da ketiv haruach, hahu deishtemoda hashshemesh setam, deishtemoda (sefer acher leitchabbera begufa deihu shimsha hahu deishtemoda) chulaka deyisrael.

Veal sevivotav shav haruach, man sevivotav. illen avahan, deinnun reticha kaddisha, veinnun telat, vedavid ved ruche deitchabberan behu (70 veda rucha daatachebarea behu) (sefer acher vedavid da hu rucha reviaa, deitchabbar behu) ha innun reticha kaddisha shelemata, veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 118:22) even maasu habbonim hayta lerosh pinna.

Begin dechol milloy dishlomo malka setimin kullehu bechachmeta, vechullehu lego bego dehechala kaddisha, uvene nasha la mistakkele behu, vechaman milloy kemillin debar nash achara. i hachi, ma shevacha hu lishlomo malka bechachmateh, mishshear bene nasha. ella vadday kol milla umilla dishlomo malka satim bechachmeta.

Patach veamar, (Kohelet 7:11) tova chachma im nachala veyoter leroe hashshamesh, i lav deha itgalyay milla da, la (shemana velo) yedana may kaamar. tova chachma, da hi chachma, dehi tachat hashshamesh, (sefer acher lechuresyay) kuresyay mittakna leh. tova chachma im nachala, yaa veshappira kad ihi sharyay immehon deyisrael, deinnun nachala veadva dilah, leitkashshera bah.

Aval tushebachta yattir leroe hashshamesh, leinnun dezachu leitchabbera beshimsha, uleitkashshera beh, deha achid beilana dechayye, uman deachid beh, becholla achid, bachayyin dehay alma, uvechayye dealma deate, veda hu dichtiv, (Kohelet 7:12) veyitron daat hachachma techayye vealeha. may veyitron daat. da ilana dechayye. yitron dileh mahu, hachachma vadday, deha tora, (Shemot 62 amud alef) mechachma illaa nafka.

Tu tova chachma im nachala, tova chachma, vadday im nachala, da tzaddika dealma, deihu nehora deshimsha, deha teren dargin illen kachada yatve, veda hu shepiru dilhon, aval veyoter leroe hashshamesh, leinnun demitachadin beshimsha, tukepa decholla, shevacha decholla.

Veda hu daat, ilana dechayye, veha ukemuha (Mishlei 19:2) gam belo daat nefesh lo tov. man nefesh. da nefesh tov dedavid malka. veda chachma dekaamran. uvegine kach yitron daat hachachma, demittamman ishtarsha ilana veitneta lechol sitrin, vechen lechol innun daachidan beh behay ilana, veal da shelomo malka la ishtechach ella behahu darga dileh, umittamman yada kolla, vahava amar od raiti tachat hashshamesh, veshavti veraiti vegomer. vechen kullehu. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta, veyadin orchoy demalka kaddisha, usetimin illain dignizin beorayyta, dichtiv, (Hoshea 14:10) ki yesharim darche Adonai vegomer. (chaser)

(Bamidbar 20:24) yeasef aharon el ammav vegomer. ribbi chiyyay patach, (Kohelet 4:2) veshabbeach ani et hammetim shekkevar metu vegomer. hay kera ittemar veukemuha. ta chaze, kol ovadoy dekudesha berich hu, bedina ukeshot, velet man deakshe lokovleh, veyimche bideh, veyemar leh ma avdat, vechiruteh aved becholla.
1395: Et hammetim. vechi shelomo malka meshabbach lemetayyay yattir min chayyay, veha la ikre chay ella man deihu beorach keshot behay alma, kema deat amer (Shmuel 2 23:20) uvenayahu ven yehoyada ben ish chay, veha (Bereshit 6 amud alef, 164 amud alef, 207 amud bet) ukemuha chavrayyay, verasha dela azil beorach keshot ikre met, veihu meshabbeach lammetim min hachayyim.

Ella, vadday kol milloy dishlomo malka, bechachmeta ittemaru, veha ittemar, veshabbeach ani et hammetim, illu la ketiv yattir, hava amena hachi, aval kevan dichtiv shekkevar metu, ishtechach milla achara bechachmeta. shekkevar metu: zimna achara istelaku min alma, veittakkan beafra, (daazademanea di memana aleh umit bechayye alma divgin deyittakkan 0 1 batar deishtelim zimneh mit vadday hu shevacha mishshear matay alma. i tema lo itdan zimna achara behahu alma, dichtiv lo takum peamim tzara) kol shekken deha kabbil onsha zimna uteren, veda vadday, atreh ittakkan bishvacha yattir meinnun chayye, dead la kabbilu onsha.

Veal da ketiv veshabbeach ani et hammetim shekkevar metu, dayyka, illen innun chayyin, veikrun metim. may tama ikrun metim, begin deha taamu taama demota, veaf al gav dekayyeyme behay alma, metim innun, umibben metayyay ahadru. veod al ovadin kadmain kayymin leatkena, veikrun metim. min hachayyim asher hemma chayyim, dead la taamu taama demota, vela kabbilu onshayyhu, vela yade i zakkan behahu alma vei lav.

Ta chaze, zakkain dezakkaan leitkashshera bitzrora dechayye, innun zakkain lemechome bikara demalka illaa kaddisha, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 27:4) lachazot benoam Adonai ulevakker behechalo. veinnun madorehon, yattir veillaa mikkol innun malachin kaddishin, vechol dargin dilhon. deha hahu atra (sefer acher chedva) illaa, la zakkain illain vetattain lemechome leh, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha vegomer.

Veinnun dela zakkan lesalleka kol kach keinnun, (sefer acher ducheta, it vechulei) duchetayay it lon letatta kefum orchayyhu, veillen la zakkan lehahu atar, ulemechome kema dechaman innun dilella, veillen kayyme bekiyyuma deeden tattaa vela yattir. vei tema man eden tattaa. ella da eden deikre chachma tattaa, veda kayyeyma al gan divara, veashgachuta dehay eden aleh (velo yattir), veillen kayyme behay gan, veithanun meeden da.

May ben eden tattaa leillaa. kitron haor min hachoshech, eden tattaa, ikre edna nukeba. eden illaa, ikre eden dechar, aleh ketiv ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha. hay eden tattaa, ikre gan leeden dilella, vehay gan ikre eden, legan diltatta. veillen demishtakkeche began tattaa, ithanun mehay eden dealayyhu, bechol shabbat veshabbat, uvechol yarcha veyarcha, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 66:23) vehaya midde chodesh bechadsho umidde shabbat beshabbato.

Veal illen amar shelomo, min hachayyim asher hemma chayyim adenna, deha illen bedarga illaa yattir minnayyhu. man innun. innun shekkevar metu, vekabbilu onsha tere zimne, veillen ikrun kesef mezukkak, deal lenura zimnin uteren, venafik minneh zuhama, veitbarar veitnake. (Kohelet 4:3) vetov mishshenehem et asher aden lo haya. hahu rucha dekaim leella, veitakkav lenachta letatta, dehay kaim bekiyyumeh, velet leh lekabbela onsha, veit leh mezona mehahu mezona
1396: Tav mekullehu, man dela itperash, vela itgalyay, vechol milloy bistima innun. da hu zakkaa chasida, denatar pikkude orayyta, vekiyyem lon, veishtaddal beorayyta yemama velele. da itachid veithane bedarga illaa al kol shear bene nasha, vechullehu itachadan (sefer acher atevakedan) mechuppa dehay.

Ta chaze, beshaata deamar kudesha berich hu lemoshe yeasef aharon el ammav, itchalash chela dileh, veyada deha attebar (tetzavve 181 amud alef) deroa yemina dileh, veizdazea kol gufeh, kevan deamar kach et aharon veet elazar beno, amar leh kudesha berich hu, moshe, ha deroa achara ozifna lach (zameyneyt lecha), vehafeshet et aharon vegomer, veaharon yeasef, he elazar yehe legabbach, zimna (nusach acher yemina) da techot avoy. veim kol da la ashlim atar behahu zimna kaavoy, deha anane yekar istelaku, vela ahadru ella bizchuta demoshe, vela bizchuta deelazar.

(Bamidbar 20:27) vayyaas moshe kaasher tzivva vegomer. amay leene kol haeda. ella, begin deaharon hava rechima deamma, yattir mikkolla, vela yemrun deha itnegid al yeda demoshe. umoshe mashich leaharon bemillin, ad desaliku letura, vechol yisrael havo chaman, beshaata deafshit moshe levushe deaharon, vealbish lon leelazar.

May taama moshe (nusach acher uleaharon). ella moshe albishinun leaharon kad salik lechahana, hada hu dichtiv veyalbesh moshe et aharon et begadav, uchetiv (Vayikra 8:7) veyalbesh oto et hammeil. hasheta. moshe ade minneh, ma deyahav leh. vekudesha berich hu ade minneh, ma deyahav leh. vetarvavyyhu afshitu leh leaharon mikkolla, umoshe ade levar, vekudesha berich hu lego. vead deade moshe, kudesha berich hu la ade, zakkaa chulaka demoshe.

Zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, dekudesha berich hu bae bikarehon. atkin kudesha berich hu leaharon, arsa umenarta dedahava denahara. umiddideh natil, mehahu menarta dehava dalik bechol yoma tere zimne veastim pum mearta venachtu.

Ribbi yehuda amar, pum mearta hava peticha, dechol yisrael havo chaman leaharon shachiv, uvutzina dimnarta dalik kammeh, vearseh nafik veayil, vaanana chad kaim aleh. ucheden yadu yisrael deha aharon mit. vechamu deha istelaku anane kavod, hada hu dichtiv vayyiru kol haeda ki gava aharon vegomer, veha ukemuha. veal da bachu leaharon kol bet yisrael, guverin venashin vetaf, deha rechima mekullehu hava.

Ribbi shimon amar, hane telata achin illain kaddishin, amay la itkavaru beatar chad, veshayyfin itbadru, chad hacha, vechad hacha, vechad beatar achara. ella it deamre, baatar devaan yisrael leistakkena beh, mit kol chad vechad, begin leaggana alayyhu, veishtezvun, aval kol chad vechad mit kaddeka chaze alayyhu. miryam bekadesh, ben tzafon ledarom. aharon listar yemina. moshe kaddeka chaze leh. achid hahu tura letura deaharon, vechanish likvurata demiryam legabbe hahu tura, achid litre sitre. veal da itkere har haavarim, ditre sitre tura dimavre, veachid lesitra da ulesitra da.

Zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay bealma den uvealma deate. veaf al gav deinnun baatar achara, bealma achara illaa, zechutehon kayyeyma bealma da, ledare darin. uveshaata deyisrael tayyvin betiyyuveta kamme kudesha berich hu, ugezera itgezar alayyhu, keden kare kudesha berich hu letzaddikayyay dekayyme kammeh leella, veoda lon, veinnun mevattele hahi gezera, vechayes kudesha berich hu alayyhu deyisrael. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, dealayyhu ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:11) venachacha Adonai tamid vegomer.
(Bamidbar 21:5) vaydabber haam belohim uvemoshe vegomer. parsheta da, baatar achara istalik, im innun me meriva demoshe veaharon.
Ribbi yitzchak patach, (Ester Adonai:1) vayhi bayom hashshelishi
1397: Vattilbash ester malchut vegomer. megilat ester beruach hakkodesh neemra, uvegin kach ketuva ben hakketuvim. vayhi bayom hashshelishi, deitchalash chela degufa, veha kayyeyma berucha bela gufa, keden vattilbash ester malchut. may (189 amud bet) malchut. i tema bilvushe yekar veargevavna, ha lav hachi ikre. ella vattilbash ester malchut, deitlabbeshat bemalchut illaa kaddisha, vadday lavsha ruach hakkodesh. may taama zachta lehay atar. begin denatra puma dela lechavava midi. hada hu dichtiv, (Ester 2:20) en ester maggedet moladta. veolifna kol man denatir pumeh velishaneh, zache leitlabbesha beruach dekudesha. vechol man desate pumeh lemilla bisha, ha vadday hahu milla bisha aleh. (sefer acher vei lav), vei tema ha negaim, o tzaraat, demokdan kechivya aleh, veha ukemuha.

Vaydabber haam belohim uvemoshe. deamru milla bisha bekudesha berich hu, uchetargumo. veim moshe natzu. lamma heelitunu, shavu kol appayay shavvevyan begin kach izdeman legabbayyhu chivvyayn, demokdan lon keeshsha, veayyil eshsha lemeayyhu venaflin metin, kema deat amer vayshalach Adonai baam et hanechashim hasserafim.

Ribbi chiyyay amar, chivvyan havo atyayn, melachashan befumayyhu, venashchin umetin. may melachashan. kema deat amer (Kohelet 10:11) im yishshoch hannachash belo lachash. eshsha havo melahatan befumayyhu, venashchin, veshadyayn eshsha behu, veittokdan meayyhu umetin veha millin illen istelaku laatar achara.

(Bamidbar 21:16) umisham beera hiv habbeer. may shena dehacha beera, ulevatar beer. ella beera, levatar demitkanshe mayyay lego yamma, venachte letatta. beer, beshaata deyitzchak malleyay leh. hi habbeer, hu ketiv veraza da, kema dichtiv, (Bamidbar 18:23) veavad hallevi hu.

Ribbi abba amar, bechol atar hu, vekarenan hi, dechar venukeba kachada. uchelala illaa, Adonai nukeba, 6 (285 amud bet, pikkude 235 amud bet) dechar, 1 kelala decholla. deha 1 bishlimu sharya. zakkain innun yisrael, af al gav deinnun letatta, innun achidan bichlala illaa decholla, uvegin kach ketiv (tehillim 100) hu asanu velo anachnu, bealef ketiv. kelala dev ve dechalil kolla.

Rabbi shimon amar, ruach demayya, da hu ruach hakkodesh, denashav bekadmita. kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim 4:16) hafichi ganni, levatar nazlin mayyay lemalyya lah, (kolla) hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 147:18) yashshev rucho yizzelu mayim. yashshev rucho bekadmita, ulevatar yizzelu mayim. vead la nashiv hay rucha, la nazlin mayyay. may ka mashma lan, mashma devae becholla leatteara milla, beovada o bemilla, o leitchazaa kechezu deovada. vehacha, ad derucha la nashiv, la nazlin mayyay legabbeh dehahu ruach.

Hu habbeer, hi habbeer karenan, may shena bekadmita beera, vehasheta beer, ella bekadmita nukeba bilchodaha, vehasheta dekaamar hu, kelala didchar venukeba, ikre beer. uvaatar deishtechach dechar, afillu mea nukeba, dechar karenan lecholla.

Asher amar Adonai lemoshe esof et haam, begin dehay beer la ade (beer) minnayyhu. vei tema, hech yachlin leshaava minneh kolla, ella ihu nafik litlesar nachalin, unevia itmelle venafik lechol sitrin, ucheden havo yisrael beshaata desharan uvayayn mayyay, kayymin aleh, veamre shirata. uma amre, ali veer. salki memayich, leanpaka mayin lecholla, uleitshakaa minach. vechen amre tushebachta dehay beer, beer chafaruha sarim vegomer. milla keshot havo amre, vechach hu.

Mehacha olifna (nusach acher ta chaze), kol man devae leatteara millin dilella, ben beovada ben bemilla. i hahu ovada, o hahu milla, la itavid kaddeka yaut, la ittear midi. kol bene alma azlin leve kenishta leatteara milla dilella, aval zeirin innun deyadin leatteara, vekudesha berich hu kariv lecholla deyade lemikre leh uleatara milla kaddeka yaut, aval i la yade lemikre leh, lav ihu kariv, dichtiv (Tehillim 145:9) karov Adonai lechol korav vegomer. may veemet. deyade leatteara milla dikshot kaddeka yaut, vechen becholla.
Uf hacha, havo amre yisrael hane millin, millin dikshot, begin leatteara
1398: Lehay bera, uleashkaa lon leyisrael, vead deamre hane mille la ittear. vechen afillu beinnun charashe alma, demishtamshe bezinin bishin, ad deavde ovadoy dikshot legabbayyhu, i la amru mille dikshot, begin leamshacha lon behane gevavna devayayn, la mitarin legabbayyhu, vaafillu detzavvche kol yoma bemillin acharanin, o beovada achara, la mashchin lon legabbayyhu lealmin, vela mitarin lokkovlayyhu.

Ta chaze, ketiv, (Melachim 1 18:26) veyikreu veshem habbaal vegomer. may taama. chad delav reshu behahu baal behay. veod demillin la mitkashsheran benayyhu, veanshe lon kudesha berich hu minnehon. hada hu dichtiv, (Melachim 1 18:37) veatta hasibbota et libbam achorannit. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, deyade lemikre lemarehon kaddeka yaut.

Amar ribbi shimon, hacha baena legallaa milla. ta chaze, kol man deyada lesaddera ovada kaddeka yaut, ulesaddera millin kaddeka yaut, ha vday matare lekudesha berich hu, leamshacha millin illain demitkashran. (sefer acher vei lo, lo itkeshar legabbayyhu). vela ichshar legabbayyhu i hachi kol alma yade lesaddera ovada, ulesaddera millin, may chashivu dilhon detzaddikayyay, deyade ikkara demilla veovada, veyade lechavvevna libba ureuta, yattir meillen acharanin, dela yade kol kach.
Ella illen dela yade ikkara deovada kule hay, ella siddura bealma vela yattir, mashchin alayyhu meshichu devatar katfoy dekudesha berich hu, dela tas baavira dishgichu ikre.

Veillen deyade umechavvevne libba ureuta, mappeke birchan meatar demachashava, venafke bechol gizin vesharashin beorach meshar kaddeka yaut, ad demitbarchin illain vetattain, ushema kaddisha illaa mitbarach al yedehon. zakkaa chulakehon. deha kudesha berich hu kariv legabbehon, vezammin lokovlehon, beshaata dekarun leh, hu zammin lon. beshaata deinnun beaku, hu legabbayyhu, hu okir lon bealma den uvealma deate, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 91:14) ki vi chashak vaafalletehu asaggevehu ki yada shemi.

(Bamidbar 21:34) vayyomer Adonai el moshe al tira oto vegomer. ribbi yehuda patach, (Mishlei 31:21) lo tira levetah mishshaleg ki chol beta lavush shanim. ta chaze, keneset yisrael yanka mittere sitre, hasheta berachame, hasheta bedina. kad baya leyanka berachame, ishtechach atar leityashsheva beh. kad bae leyanka bedina, atar ishtechach leityashsheva beh, ulemishre alohi, dehachi hu bechol atar, la share milla dilella, ad deishtechach atar lemishre aloy. veal da, keneset yisrael lo tira leveta mishshaleg, may tama, begin dechol beta lavush shanim. la sharya hay, ella behay chivvavr besumak, vesumak bechivvavr. veha okmuha.

Vayyomer Adonai el moshe al tira oto, teren oto innun shelemin beorayyta bitren vavin, chad da, vechad, (Devarim 22:2) ad derosh achicha oto. may tama. begin deinnun ot mammash. ad derosh achicha (achicha mammash) oto, devae lefarsha hahu ot, dehahu aveda.

Uf hacha den oto, da og, deitdabbak beavraham, umeanshe beteh hava, vechad itgezar avraham ma ketiv, vechol anshe veto vegomer. da og deitgezar immeh, vekabbil hay at kaddisha, kevan dechama og deyisrael mekarvin gabbeh, amar ha vday ana akdimna zechuta dekaim lon, veda shavvi lekavleh.

Beh shaata dachil moshe, hech yachil leakera reshima derashim avraham. amar, vadday ha yemina dili mit, deha yemina baya lehay. i nema ha elazar, yemina desihara hu, vela dili. vehay at limina hu, deavraham limina hu.

Miyyad amar kudesha berich hu, al tira oto, la tiddechal lehahu ot dileh, vaafillu limina la itzterich. ki veyadcha natatti. semala dilach yakar leh mealma, deha hu pagim reshima dileh, uman defagim lehay at, itchaze leitakkera mealma, kol shekken semala dilach, deihu yedach, yekar leh mealma, begin kach
1399: Itteakar mealma, vaafillu deihu takkifa mibbene gavrayyay, uvaa leshetzaa lehu leyisrael, nafal bideh demoshe veishtetze.

Begin kach kolla shetziu yisrael benoy vechol ammeh, vechol dileh. kema dichtiv, vayyakku oto veet banav veet kol ammo uchetiv, (Devarim 2:33) vannach oto veet banav. beno ketiv chaser yod, vekarenan banav, veha ukemuha chavrayyay.

Zakkain innun yisrael, demoshe nevia hava benayyhu, divgineh avid lon kudesha berich hu kol hane atvavn, veokmuha. vekudesha berich hu la gazar kayyaymeh im shear ammin leitkashshera beh, ella im yisrael, deinnun benoy deavraham, dichtiv bo (Bereshit 17:7) uven zaracha acharecha ledorotam berit olam. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 59:21) vaani zot beriti otam amar Adonai ruchi asher alecha vegomer. lo yamushu mippicha vegomer. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen
